reason.zh: 旧题近似重现定义与引导；改判断材料不能证明什么
reason.en: Replace definition-like repetition with limits of incomplete evidence

learnerGoal.zh: 架构证据缺失时不冒认DL
learnerGoal.en: Do not assert DL without architectural evidence

title.zh: 深度学习证据筛选器

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练评审三份方案说明，选择所有直接支持“使用深度学习方法”的描述。
prompt.en: Review three exercise proposal statements and select every one directly supporting the use of deep learning.

text.zh: 用多层神经网络从数据学习表示
text.en: Uses a multilayer neural network to learn representations from data

text.zh: 只说应用很智能，没有模型结构说明
text.en: Only says the application is intelligent, with no architecture

text.zh: 只是人工列出固定审批条件
text.en: Only lists fixed approval conditions written by people

reason.zh: 多层神经网络学习表示是定义中的关键证据；宣传措辞或固定条件没有证明这一点。DL属于ML，不是随后发生的阶段。 回看“深度学习证据筛选器”关联知识。
reason.en: A multilayer neural network learning representations is the defining evidence. Marketing wording or fixed conditions does not establish it. DL belongs within ML rather than occurring later as a stage. Revisit the knowledge linked to Deep-learning evidence selector.

title.zh: 架构证据缺失时不冒认DL
title.en: Do not assert DL without architectural evidence

brief.zh: 学习目标：架构证据缺失时不冒认DL。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Do not assert DL without architectural evidence. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 供应商材料说：系统从历史样本更新参数，并能产生预测。宣传页写着“深度智能”，但没有计算节点、连接或网络层结构说明。评审现在可以支持哪些判断和后续要求？不要把未提供的架构当成已知。
prompt.en: A supplier says its system updates parameters from historical examples and produces predictions. Marketing calls it deep intelligence, but provides no computational-node, connection or network-layer description. Which judgments and requests are supported now? Do not treat missing architecture as known.

reason.zh: 从样本调整参数支持学习型方法的描述，不自动证明多层神经网络；“深度智能”是宣传词，缺架构应保留未知而非肯定或否定DL。回看“深度学习、神经网络”。
reason.en: Parameter adjustment from examples supports a learning-based description, not automatically a multilayer neural network. Marketing is not architecture; preserve uncertainty rather than affirm or deny DL without evidence. Revisit Deep learning and Neural networks.

text.zh: 宣传出现“深度”就证明使用多层神经网络
text.en: The word deep in marketing proves a multilayer neural network

text.zh: 要求补充可核验的模型结构资料，再判断是否符合DL特征
text.en: Request verifiable model-architecture material before judging DL characteristics

text.zh: 已有数据学习的描述，但现有材料不足以确认深度学习
text.en: There is a description of data learning, but insufficient material to confirm deep learning

text.zh: 能产生预测就证明DL不属于ML
text.en: Producing predictions proves DL is outside ML

reason.zh: 原排序照题面箭头；改查真实结构证据
reason.en: Arrow copying becomes architectural evidence evaluation

learnerGoal.zh: 辨认可学习连接计算结构
learnerGoal.en: Recognize learnable connected computation

title.zh: 神经网络连线组装

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练网络图只给三个层卡，边为输入层→中间层、中间层→输出层，各边带可学习权重。沿给定边组装计算路径。三层仅是本题图，不是所有网络的固定结构。
prompt.en: This exercise graph has three layer cards with edges input→middle and middle→output, each with learnable weights. Assemble the computation path along those edges. Three layers describe this diagram only, not every network.

text.zh: 中间层按权重计算
text.en: Middle layer computes with weights

text.zh: 输出层产生本次结果
text.en: Output layer produces this result

text.zh: 输入层接收本次输入
text.en: Input layer receives this input

reason.zh: 给定边决定计算依赖。连接节点与可学习权重构成这里的模型；此装配说明计算路径，不是训练时间线，也不证明结果正确。 回看“神经网络连线组装”关联知识。
reason.en: The given edges determine computational dependencies. Connected nodes and learnable weights form this model; the assembly represents computation, not a training timeline or correctness proof. Revisit the knowledge linked to Neural-network path assembly.

title.zh: 辨认可学习连接计算结构

brief.zh: 学习目标：辨认可学习连接计算结构。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Recognize learnable connected computation. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 技术评审收到三项材料。哪些材料能支持“这里确实有神经网络计算结构”，而不只是把界面画成三个方框？选择全部有用的结构证据。
prompt.en: Reviewers receive three materials. Which support an actual neural-network computation structure rather than three boxes drawn in an interface? Select all useful architectural evidence.

reason.zh: 节点计算、连接和可学习权重是结构证据；三个标题只描述界面，不证明模型结构。能区分结构与示意图才算理解，不能靠沿已画好的箭头照排。回看“神经网络”。
reason.en: Node computations, connections and learnable weights are architectural evidence. Three headings describe an interface, not a model structure. Revisit Neural networks.

text.zh: 输入如何经过相连节点的计算传到结果的记录
text.en: A trace of how input propagates through connected-node computations to the result

text.zh: 界面上只有“输入、处理、输出”三个标题
text.en: Only interface headings saying input, process and output

text.zh: 计算节点之间的连接以及各连接使用的可学习权重
text.en: Connections among computational nodes and the learnable weights used by those connections

reason.zh: 原题完整交代箭头链；改为目标驱动步骤搭建
reason.en: Replace supplied order with goal-driven procedure construction

learnerGoal.zh: 构造可执行方法
learnerGoal.en: Construct an executable method

title.zh: 可执行算法装配轨

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练算法约定：读入金额后才能比较，比较完成后才能记录动作。把执行卡组装成可运行顺序；这不是所有算法的统一流程。
prompt.en: Exercise algorithm: read the amount before comparison, then record the action after comparison. Assemble the executable sequence; this is not a universal algorithm lifecycle.

text.zh: 依给定条件比较金额
text.en: Compare it against the given condition

text.zh: 记录本笔动作
text.en: Record the action for this case

text.zh: 读入本笔金额
text.en: Read this amount

reason.zh: 先用输入完成比较再产出动作，顺序由题面依赖决定；算法是执行方法，不是训练后的模型。 回看“可执行算法装配轨”关联知识。
reason.en: Input is needed for comparison before recording the result. The stated dependencies determine order; the algorithm is a method, not a trained model. Revisit the knowledge linked to Executable algorithm assembly track.

title.zh: 构造可执行方法

brief.zh: 学习目标：构造可执行方法。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Construct an executable method. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 门店要给本批金额最高的一笔订单加“优先复核”标记。资料还没读入，最高金额也未知。把这些可执行工作卡连接成能完成任务的方法；卡片的前一步必须产生后一步要用的信息。
prompt.en: A store must mark the highest-value order in this batch for priority review. The records have not been read and the highest value is unknown. Connect executable work cards so each step produces information used by the next.

reason.zh: 找最大值要先取得记录，写标记又要先确定订单。能按信息依赖构造方法，才是理解算法；不是照抄一条已给出的箭头链。回看“算法”。
reason.en: Finding a maximum needs the records; marking needs the identified order. Constructing the information dependencies demonstrates an executable method. Revisit Algorithm.

text.zh: 给找到的订单写入优先复核标记
text.en: Mark that identified order for priority review

text.zh: 从读入记录中找到最高金额订单
text.en: Find the highest-value order in the read records

text.zh: 读取本批订单与金额
text.en: Read this batch of orders and amounts

reason.zh: 删除history/forecast抄码，改为业务职责分类
reason.en: Remove history/forecast transcription; classify functional roles

learnerGoal.zh: 区分业务输入、估计输出与下游行动
learnerGoal.en: Separate inputs, estimates and downstream actions

title.zh: 输入—映射—输出接线板

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练接线中，history表示过去销量，forecast表示对下周的估计。已训练模型接收前者产生后者。错误接线为输入forecast、输出history。填写两个固定英文代码修复，模型本身不变。
prompt.en: Exercise wiring: history means past sales and forecast means the next-week estimate. A trained model receives the former and produces the latter. Faulty wiring has input forecast and output history. Repair both using those exact codes without changing the model.

reason.zh: 模型把输入映射到输出；历史记录是本题输入，未来估计是输出。交换槽位会破坏任务定义，接线正确仍不证明预测准确。 回看“输入—映射—输出接线板”关联知识。
reason.en: The model maps inputs to outputs: historical records are inputs and the future estimate is the output here. Reversed slots break the task definition, while correct wiring still does not prove accuracy. Revisit the knowledge linked to Input–mapping–output wiring board.

title.zh: 区分业务输入、估计输出与下游行动
title.en: Separate inputs, estimates and downstream actions

brief.zh: 学习目标：区分业务输入、估计输出与下游行动。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Separate inputs, estimates and downstream actions. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 维修中心用模型预估设备何时需要检查。中心先测得振动和温度，模型给出预计剩余运行小时，调度员再决定哪台先检修。把三份材料放进各自职责区，不用输入任何英文代码。
prompt.en: A maintenance center uses a model to estimate when equipment needs inspection. It measures vibration and temperature; the model estimates remaining operating hours; a dispatcher decides inspection priority. Place each material in its functional area; no code entry is needed.

reason.zh: 输入来自待处理业务的测量，输出是模型给出的估计；人员据此安排工作仍是下游行动。把行动当成模型输入，或把估计当成已观察事实，都会混淆职责。回看“模型”。
reason.en: Inputs are measurements from the current task; outputs are estimates; human scheduling is downstream action. An estimate is not an observed fact, and an action is not the model input here. Revisit Model.

text.zh: 业务提供给模型的资料
text.en: Business information supplied to the model

text.zh: 模型产生的估计
text.en: Estimate produced by the model

text.zh: 人员使用结果作出的行动
text.en: Human action using the result

text.zh: 本次温度与振动测量值
text.en: Current temperature and vibration measurements

text.zh: 还可运行约18小时的估计
text.en: An estimate of about 18 operating hours remaining

text.zh: 把设备排入明早检修队列
text.en: Schedule the device for inspection tomorrow morning

reason.zh: 照排已给验收路径不能证明理解；改判断和依据两轮
reason.en: Replace copied evaluation order with judgment and evidence

learnerGoal.zh: 用参数变化识别训练并独立验证
learnerGoal.en: Identify training by parameter change and validate independently

title.zh: 训练与独立验证工作台

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练约定：先保留独立验收样本；再只用训练样本调整参数；最后在保留样本上检验。不允许把验收答案带入训练。组装本次验收路径。
prompt.en: Exercise rule: reserve independent acceptance examples first, adjust parameters only on training examples, then evaluate on the reserved examples. Acceptance answers must not enter training. Assemble this case path.

text.zh: 只用训练样本调整参数
text.en: Fit parameters only on training examples

text.zh: 检查保留样本表现
text.en: Check performance on reserved examples

text.zh: 保留独立验收样本
text.en: Reserve independent acceptance examples

reason.zh: 保留样本用于检验未见情况；泄漏后再高的分数也不能提供独立证据。题面顺序是防泄漏演练，不是所有训练工作的完整生命周期。 回看“训练与独立验证工作台”关联知识。
reason.en: Reserved cases test unseen performance. High scores after leakage are not independent evidence. The sequence is a leakage-prevention exercise, not a complete universal training lifecycle. Revisit the knowledge linked to Training and independent-validation workbench.

title.zh: 用参数变化识别训练并独立验证
title.en: Identify training by parameter change and validate independently

brief.zh: 学习目标：用参数变化识别训练并独立验证。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Identify training by parameter change and validate independently. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 语音团队记录两项工作：甲反复比较旧录音的预测与人工结果，把差异用于改变连接权重；乙锁定刚保存的权重，为一段新录音给出文字。按记录勾选各工作实际发生的事情，不根据“新结果”三个字判断。
prompt.en: A speech team records two jobs. Job A repeatedly compares predictions on old recordings with human outcomes and uses the differences to change connection weights. Job B locks the saved weights and produces text for a new recording. Mark what actually happens in each job rather than judging from the phrase new result.

reason.zh: 甲的关键是参数改变；乙只使用已有参数。训练分数仍不能证明未见录音也可靠。把产生新文字误当参数学习，说明没分清训练和运行。回看“训练、推理”。
reason.en: Job A changes parameters; Job B uses existing ones. Training scores still do not establish reliability on unseen recordings. New text does not imply parameter learning. Revisit Training and Inference.

text.zh: 甲：利用差异改变权重
text.en: A: changes weights using differences

text.zh: 乙：锁定权重处理新录音
text.en: B: processes new audio with locked weights

text.zh: 本次参数发生学习调整
text.en: Parameters are adjusted through learning

text.zh: 以已有参数处理这次新输入
text.en: Existing parameters process this new input

prompt.zh: 甲在旧录音上全部识别正确。现在要证明它能处理另一家门店的新录音，还缺哪项证据？
prompt.en: Job A recognizes all old recordings correctly. What is still needed to support use on a different store’s new recordings?

reason.zh: 训练证据和泛化证据不能互相代替；独立样本必须未参与本次学习。回看“训练”。
reason.en: Training evidence and generalization evidence are distinct; independent cases must not have participated in fitting. Revisit Training.

text.zh: 再展示一次旧录音高分
text.en: Show the old-recording score again

text.zh: 把新录音答案加入参数调整再称独立检验
text.en: Use the new answers for fitting and call the result independent

text.zh: 用未参与参数调整、符合新用途的独立录音检验
text.en: Evaluate independent recordings not used for parameter fitting and relevant to the new use

reason.zh: 原两项近似定义配对；改三种新日志
reason.en: Replace two definition-like items with three new logs

learnerGoal.zh: 用参数证据判断推理并保留未知
learnerGoal.en: Identify inference from parameter evidence and retain uncertainty

title.zh: 推理 Inference应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：把每项观察或任务放入对应类别。
prompt.en: In this exercise: put each observation or task in its matching category.

reason.zh: 看参数是否被调整，不能因生成了新文字就认定发生训练。 回看“推理 Inference”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Check whether parameters change; new text alone does not imply training. Revisit Inference and check the evidence.

text.zh: 训练
text.en: Training

text.zh: 推理
text.en: Inference

text.zh: 用样本调整参数
text.en: Adjust parameters with examples

text.zh: 使用已有参数回复新工单
text.en: Use existing parameters to answer a new ticket

title.zh: 用参数证据判断推理并保留未知
title.en: Identify inference from parameter evidence and retain uncertainty

brief.zh: 学习目标：用参数证据判断推理并保留未知。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Identify inference from parameter evidence and retain uncertainty. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 在线翻译服务出现三段日志：一次运行冻结参数处理刚上传的段落；另一次后台用纠错样本改变模型权重；第三段只写“结果变了”，没有参数记录。按证据能支持的结论归类。
prompt.en: An online translator has three logs: one freezes parameters and processes a newly uploaded paragraph; another changes weights using corrected examples; a third merely says the result changed, with no parameter trace. Classify only what the evidence supports.

reason.zh: 推理看是否使用已有参数，训练看是否发生学习调整；结果不同本身不足以断言训练。第三项应保留不确定性，不能按“新输出”猜。回看“推理”。
reason.en: Inference uses existing parameters; training adjusts them through learning. Different results alone do not prove training, so preserve uncertainty for the third log. Revisit Inference.

text.zh: 使用已有模型的推理
text.en: Inference using an existing model

text.zh: 改变模型的训练
text.en: Training that changes the model

text.zh: 证据不足以区分
text.en: Insufficient evidence to distinguish

text.zh: 参数文件未写入，对新段落产生译文
text.en: No parameter writes; a translation is produced for a new paragraph

text.zh: 纠错误差用于更新权重并保存新参数
text.en: Correction errors update weights and save new parameters

text.zh: 只记录两次结果不同，没有参数变化信息
text.en: Only different results are recorded, with no parameter-change information

reason.zh: 原题照排明示循环；改计算加依据
reason.en: Replace a supplied loop with arithmetic and rationale

learnerGoal.zh: 以累计回报评价行动策略
learnerGoal.en: Evaluate policies by cumulative return

title.zh: 奖励反馈回路组装

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练模拟一轮学习：智能体先执行选定行动，环境响应后给奖励与下一状态，智能体再用反馈改进后续策略。按本轮依赖组装；累计回报仍需跨多轮评估。
prompt.en: Exercise learning round: the agent takes its chosen action, the environment responds with reward and the next state, then the agent uses feedback to improve later policy. Assemble this round by dependency; cumulative return still requires multiple rounds.

text.zh: 取得环境响应与奖励反馈
text.en: Receive the environment response and reward

text.zh: 利用反馈改进后续策略
text.en: Use feedback to improve later policy

text.zh: 执行本轮选定行动
text.en: Take this round’s chosen action

reason.zh: 尚未行动就没有这次环境反馈；策略利用反馈而非只抄一个目标类别。单轮奖励不能代替长期累计回报。 回看“奖励反馈回路组装”关联知识。
reason.en: This action’s feedback follows the action; policy uses feedback rather than copies a category label. A single reward does not replace long-term cumulative return. Revisit the knowledge linked to Reward-feedback loop assembly.

title.zh: 以累计回报评价行动策略

brief.zh: 学习目标：以累计回报评价行动策略。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Evaluate policies by cumulative return. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 机器人演练比较两条策略的两轮奖励，不折扣也不设其他收益。甲得到6、−4；乙得到2、3。填写各策略两轮累计回报，不用第一轮大小代替整段表现。
prompt.en: A robot exercise compares two policies over two reward rounds, with no discounting or other gains. A receives 6 and −4; B receives 2 and 3. Enter each cumulative return rather than choosing from the first round alone.

reason.zh: 甲6−4=2，乙2+3=5；奖励反馈要结合后续结果。数值只属于本演练，不是所有强化学习的回报定义。回看“强化学习”。
reason.en: A: 6−4=2; B: 2+3=5. Reward feedback must include subsequent outcomes. These numbers and the no-discount assumption apply only to this exercise. Revisit Reinforcement learning.

prompt.zh: 该演练还有一种做法：只挑第一轮奖励最大的策略，并完全忽略后续回报。为什么证据不足？
prompt.en: Another approach picks whichever policy has the largest first reward and ignores later return. Why is this insufficient in the exercise?

reason.zh: 能解释第一轮与累计回报的差别，才不只是算一次加法。回看“强化学习”。
reason.en: Explaining immediate versus cumulative reward distinguishes understanding from arithmetic alone. Revisit Reinforcement learning.

text.zh: 行动策略应以给定时段累计回报比较，第一轮较高可能随后受损
text.en: Policies should be compared by the stated cumulative return; a high first reward can be followed by loss

text.zh: 奖励只是人工类别标签，与环境行动无关
text.en: Rewards are just category labels unrelated to environmental actions

text.zh: 只要有奖励就能保证长期最好
text.en: Any reward guarantees the best long-term policy

reason.zh: 删除fresh/complete等代码抄写，改实算与证据决策
reason.en: Remove diagnostic-code transcription; calculate and decide from evidence

learnerGoal.zh: 按用途核验并修复质量
learnerGoal.en: Check and repair fitness for use

title.zh: 数据质量诊断修复板

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练诊断编码：fresh=时效，complete=完整，consistent=一致。A记录缺金额却错标fresh；B两个部门对同字段含义不同却错标complete；C资料日期早于当前用途要求却错标consistent。修复三个诊断代码，不填造缺失金额。
prompt.en: Exercise diagnostic codes: fresh=timeliness, complete=completeness, consistent=consistency. A lacks an amount but is labeled fresh; B has conflicting field definitions but is labeled complete; C is too old for the stated use but is labeled consistent. Repair the three codes without inventing missing values.

reason.zh: 不同缺陷对应不同质量维度；修正诊断不是编造事实，更大模型不能自动补齐这些缺陷。 回看“数据质量诊断修复板”关联知识。
reason.en: Different defects concern different quality dimensions. Correcting a diagnosis is not inventing facts, and a bigger model cannot automatically repair these defects. Revisit the knowledge linked to Data-quality diagnosis repair board.

title.zh: 按用途核验并修复质量
title.en: Check and repair fitness for use

brief.zh: 学习目标：按用途核验并修复质量。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Check and repair fitness for use. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练用于按订单统计收入。负责人已核实两条B记录是同一笔订单被重复导入，其他记录各是一笔：A=50，B=70，B=70，C=90。修复统计结果，填写真实订单数和收入合计。
prompt.en: This exercise reports revenue by order. The owner has verified the two B rows are one order imported twice; the other rows are distinct: A=50, B=70, B=70, C=90. Repair the order count and revenue total.

reason.zh: B只能计一次，因此3笔、50+70+90=210。只是字段齐全不能证明内容适用，去重须有负责人核实依据。回看“数据质量”。
reason.en: Count verified duplicate B once: three orders and 50+70+90=210. Complete fields do not guarantee fitness; deduplication requires evidence. Revisit Data quality.

prompt.zh: 另一份材料金额缺失且日期早于当前用途要求。负责人要求立刻给出可靠总额。选择仍需处理的全部事项。
prompt.en: Another source has missing amounts and is older than the use requires. The owner requests a reliable total immediately. Select every issue still requiring action.

reason.zh: 完整性和时效性都要按用途核查；已修一个重复问题不代表所有质量问题消失。回看“数据质量”。
reason.en: Check completeness and freshness against the use; fixing duplication does not resolve every quality issue. Revisit Data quality.

text.zh: 补核缺失金额，不能凭模型猜成已知
text.en: Verify missing amounts rather than treat model guesses as known

text.zh: 核对资料时效是否满足用途
text.en: Check whether freshness meets the use

text.zh: 记录是表格，所以直接宣布可靠
text.en: The records are tabular, so declare them reliable

reason.zh: 旧题与引导同问需要独立样本；改查真实使用记录
reason.en: Replace a repeated call for independent cases with a data-use audit

learnerGoal.zh: 从数据使用记录判断泛化证据范围
learnerGoal.en: Judge generalization evidence from data-use records

title.zh: 历史数据与泛化应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：历史客户多为线下，新业务转为线上。应怎样检验历史模型？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Past customers were mostly offline and the new business is online. How should the historical model be tested?

reason.zh: 历史条件并不固定延续，独立样本和环境比较共同支持泛化判断。 回看“历史数据与泛化”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Historical conditions may not persist; independent examples and environment comparison support generalization assessment. Revisit Generalization and historical data and check the evidence.

text.zh: 过去有效就永久有效
text.en: Past success guarantees permanent success

text.zh: 只重复历史训练分数
text.en: Only repeat the historical training score

text.zh: 用独立的新环境样本评估，并调查环境差异
text.en: Evaluate independent new-environment examples and investigate differences

title.zh: 从数据使用记录判断泛化证据范围
title.en: Judge generalization evidence from data-use records

brief.zh: 学习目标：从数据使用记录判断泛化证据范围。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Judge generalization evidence from data-use records. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 模型准备服务新仓库。请审查三份评估记录能支持的范围：甲使用新仓库6月记录，答案已参与本次参数调整；乙用参数冻结后才取得的新仓库7月记录，对照真实结果评估，未用于调整；丙使用未参与调整的旧仓库保留记录，但没有新仓库资料。把记录送到符合证据范围的结论区。
prompt.en: A model will serve a new warehouse. Audit three evaluation records: A uses new-warehouse June records whose answers participated in parameter fitting; B evaluates against true outcomes on new-warehouse July records collected after parameters were frozen and never used for fitting; C evaluates held-out old-warehouse records never used for fitting, with no new-warehouse data. Route each record to its supported scope.

reason.zh: 甲虽然来自新仓库却已泄漏到学习，不能作本次独立证据；丙独立但只测旧条件；乙同时满足独立与当前用途相关。乙仍只支持已测条件，不保证所有未来场景。回看“历史数据与泛化、训练集与验证”。
reason.en: A comes from the new warehouse but has entered learning, so it is not independent. C is independent but tests only old conditions. B is both independent and relevant to the current use, while still supporting only tested conditions rather than every future situation. Revisit Generalization and Evaluation Sets.

text.zh: 提供新仓库条件下的独立检验证据
text.en: Independent evaluation evidence under new-warehouse conditions

text.zh: 只提供旧仓库条件下的独立证据
text.en: Independent evidence limited to old-warehouse conditions

text.zh: 不能当作本次独立检验
text.en: Not independent evaluation of this fitting run

text.zh: 甲：新仓库记录答案已参与参数调整
text.en: A: new-warehouse answers participated in parameter fitting

text.zh: 乙：冻结参数后取得、未用于学习的新仓库记录
text.en: B: new-warehouse records obtained after freezing and not used for learning

text.zh: 丙：未用于学习、但只来自旧仓库的记录
text.en: C: never used for learning, but only from the old warehouse

reason.zh: 删除train/infer抄码，改证据归类
reason.en: Remove train/infer transcription; classify evidence

learnerGoal.zh: 以实际工作统一术语
learnerGoal.en: Align terms with actual work

title.zh: 团队术语校准板

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练统一代码：train=用样本调整参数；infer=以已有参数处理输入。日志A使用已有参数回复新工单却写train；日志B用样本调整参数却写infer。修复代码；统一术语不保证模型准确。
prompt.en: Exercise shared codes: train=adjust parameters from examples; infer=process input with existing parameters. Log A answers a new ticket with existing parameters but says train; log B adjusts parameters from examples but says infer. Repair the codes; shared terminology does not guarantee accuracy.

reason.zh: 按事件中参数是否更新区分，不按“生成新文字”猜训练。统一含义使团队能谈同一对象，但不是性能证明。 回看“团队术语校准板”关联知识。
reason.en: Distinguish events by whether parameters change, not whether new wording appears. Shared meanings help coordination but do not prove performance. Revisit the knowledge linked to Team terminology calibration board.

title.zh: 以实际工作统一术语

brief.zh: 学习目标：以实际工作统一术语。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Align terms with actual work. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 业务和技术对“模型更新”理解不同：记录甲是系统加载同一版本参数处理新投诉；乙是用纠错样本改变权重并生成新参数版本；丙只是员工修改帮助文档。请把三项工作放到准确的讨论主题下。
prompt.en: Business and engineering disagree on model update. Record A loads the same parameter version for a new complaint; B changes weights from corrected examples and saves a new parameter version; C only edits a help document. Place them under accurate discussion topics.

reason.zh: 统一词汇应让团队说清实际发生的工作，而非背内部日志代码。外部文档变化既不自动训练模型，也不证明推理表现提高。回看“AI框架与统一词汇”。
reason.en: Shared vocabulary should describe what actually happened, not require memorized log codes. A document update neither automatically trains a model nor proves improved inference. Revisit Shared AI vocabulary.

text.zh: 运行模型处理输入
text.en: Run a model on input

text.zh: 学习调整模型参数
text.en: Learn and adjust model parameters

text.zh: 维护外部资料
text.en: Maintain external material

text.zh: 甲：同一参数版本处理新投诉
text.en: A: same parameter version handles a new complaint

text.zh: 乙：纠错样本驱动权重改变
text.en: B: corrected examples drive weight changes

text.zh: 丙：只修订帮助文档正文
text.en: C: only help-document text changes

reason.zh: 删除pass/review文字输入，改边界计数
reason.en: Replace pass/review entry with boundary counting

learnerGoal.zh: 同版规则可重复执行
learnerGoal.en: Execute a fixed-version rule reproducibly

title.zh: 确定性与可重复执行应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：同版规则规定金额大于100需复核，否则通过。修复状态：输入 pass（通过）或 review（复核），使用这两个固定代码。
prompt.en: In this exercise: the same rule version requires review above 100, otherwise pass. Repair statuses using the fixed codes pass or review.

reason.zh: 固定输入与规则版本要求结果可重复；金额仅是演练政策。 回看“确定性与可重复执行”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Fixed input and rule version require repeatability; the amount is an exercise policy only. Revisit Deterministic execution and check the evidence.

title.zh: 同版规则可重复执行

brief.zh: 学习目标：同版规则可重复执行。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Execute a fixed-version rule reproducibly. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练同一版规则：金额严格大于100需复核，否则直接处理。本批金额是80、100、101、120、50。填写需复核与可直接处理的笔数；没有模型学习或规则版本变更。
prompt.en: Exercise rule version: amounts strictly greater than 100 require review; other cases proceed directly. Batch amounts are 80, 100, 101, 120 and 50. Enter the counts for review and direct handling; no learning or rule-version change occurs.

reason.zh: 101和120严格大于100；等于100仍走直接处理，所以2与3。判断依据是输入及同版明确条件，不是输入pass/review字符串。回看“确定性与可重复执行”。
reason.en: 101 and 120 are strictly above 100; equality goes to direct handling, producing counts 2 and 3. This applies an explicit rule rather than copies status codes. Revisit Deterministic execution.

reason.zh: 旧题与示范同为授权失败；改双日志对照判断
reason.en: Replace repeated denial with contrastive operational logs

learnerGoal.zh: 按实际失败类型决定重试或停止
learnerGoal.en: Decide retry versus stopping from failure evidence

title.zh: 自主性与停止条件应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：本演练代理最多重试两次，遇授权失败立即升级。首次工具调用授权失败，正确动作是什么？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The exercise agent may retry twice but must escalate immediately on authorization failure. Its first call fails authorization. What should happen?

reason.zh: 异常停止条件优先于一般重试额度，自主性不代表无限权限。 回看“自主性与停止条件”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: The exceptional stop condition overrides the general retry allowance; autonomy does not mean unlimited authority. Revisit Autonomy and stop conditions and check the evidence.

text.zh: 绕开权限限制完成目标
text.en: Bypass authorization to meet the goal

text.zh: 停止并升级给负责人
text.en: Stop and escalate to the owner

text.zh: 继续重试到两次用完
text.en: Keep retrying until both attempts are used

title.zh: 按实际失败类型决定重试或停止
title.en: Decide retry versus stopping from failure evidence

brief.zh: 学习目标：按实际失败类型决定重试或停止。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Decide retry versus stopping from failure evidence. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练代理可在不扩大权限、且没有执行副作用的前提下，对临时连接故障最多重试2次；遇到权限边界须停止交负责人。日志甲：业务工具尚未收到请求，连接超时，已重试0次。日志乙：业务工具回复“当前角色无权执行此操作”，已重试0次。分别选择此刻允许的行动。
prompt.en: Exercise policy permits up to two retries for temporary connection failures only without broader authority or executed side effects; permission boundaries require stopping and handing over to the owner. Log A: the tool has not received the request, connection timed out, zero retries used. Log B: the tool replies that the current role cannot perform the operation, zero retries used. Select the permitted action for each log.

reason.zh: 甲符合本题限定的临时失败条件，可在额度内重试；乙缺授权，不能因次数还剩而继续或自行扩权。相同剩余次数不代表相同处置，需看失败类型与副作用。回看“自主性与停止条件”。
reason.en: A meets the stated temporary-failure conditions and may retry within the allowance. B lacks authority; remaining retries do not authorize continuing or expanding permissions. Equal remaining counts do not imply equal actions; inspect failure type and side effects. Revisit Autonomy and stop conditions.

text.zh: 日志甲：请求未到工具，连接超时
text.en: Log A: request did not reach the tool; connection timeout

text.zh: 日志乙：当前角色不能执行
text.en: Log B: current role is not authorized

text.zh: 只在既定额度和权限内重试
text.en: Retry only within existing allowance and authority

text.zh: 停止并交指定负责人处置
text.en: Stop and hand over to the designated owner

reason.zh: 原题先给步骤后照排；改依赖调度分类
reason.en: Replace supplied sequence with dependency scheduling

learnerGoal.zh: 按证据依赖安排交接
learnerGoal.en: Schedule handoff by evidence dependency

title.zh: 交接与编排应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：本演练写报告必须先取得检索证据。请按依赖顺序排列交接步骤。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Report writing requires retrieval evidence first. Arrange the handoff steps by dependency.

reason.zh: 有前后依赖的任务需要串行交接，未拿到证据就写作会破坏依据链。 常见误判：跳过来源和状态交接，未指定人类处置负责人就继续执行。 回看相关知识与题面条件。
reason.en: Dependent tasks require serial handoffs; writing before evidence breaks the support chain. Common error: Continue execution without handing over sources and status or identifying a human response owner. Revisit the linked knowledge and stated case conditions.

text.zh: 撰写员依据证据形成报告
text.en: Writer produces the report from evidence

text.zh: 交接来源证据、状态、失败步骤记录及指定的人类处置负责人。
text.en: Hand over source evidence, status, failed-step records and the designated human response owner.

text.zh: 检索员收集并记录来源
text.en: Retriever collects evidence and records sources

title.zh: 按证据依赖安排交接

brief.zh: 学习目标：按证据依赖安排交接。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Schedule handoff by evidence dependency. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 一份带引用报告要引用本次检索找到的材料。当前检索员尚未产出材料，时间已经很紧。把候选安排分到“可先做”或“必须等证据与交接”。不要把赶进度当作消除依赖。
prompt.en: A referenced report must cite material found by this retrieval run. The retriever has not produced it and time is short. Route candidate arrangements to work that can start or work that must await evidence and handover. Time pressure does not remove dependencies.

reason.zh: 格式准备与检索可先开展；具体结论要用实际证据，交接还需来源、状态和人类处置负责人。能识别可并行与受阻工作，而非照给定步骤排序。回看“交接与编排”。
reason.en: Formatting and retrieval can begin; evidence-specific conclusions need actual material. Handover must retain sources, status and a human response owner. Revisit Handoffs and orchestration.

text.zh: 可先做的准备工作
text.en: Preparatory work that can start

text.zh: 必须等证据与交接
text.en: Must await evidence and handover

text.zh: 确定报告格式和交付目标
text.en: Clarify report format and delivery goal

text.zh: 检索员查找获授权资料并记录来源
text.en: Retriever searches authorized sources and records provenance

text.zh: 撰写员据本次资料写具体结论与引用
text.en: Writer states source-specific conclusions and citations

reason.zh: 独立题曾复用正式紧急回退情境；改未触发预案的常规修复决策
reason.en: Separate application from the urgent formal item using routine remediation

learnerGoal.zh: 未触发紧急条件时先查因并独立验证修复
learnerGoal.en: Investigate and independently validate when no urgent trigger is present

title.zh: 监测基线与反馈闭环应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练未触发紧急回退条件。常规监测与修复闭环应怎样排序？
prompt.en: In this exercise, urgent rollback conditions have not been met. Order the routine monitoring and remediation loop.

reason.zh: 先建立基线，监测并调查变化，选择处置措施；修复经验证后再扩大部署。若已触发组织预设的紧急回退条件，可先按预案回退，再继续调查与验证修复。 常见误判：把告警直接当作重训上线依据，或认为紧急回退必须等待修复验证完成。 回看相关知识与题面条件。
reason.en: Establish baselines, monitor and investigate changes, and select a response; validate fixes before expanding deployment. If predefined urgent rollback conditions are met, follow the rollback plan first, then continue investigation and validation. Common error: Treat an alert as sufficient grounds to retrain and deploy, or require completed fix validation before an urgent planned rollback. Revisit the linked knowledge and stated case conditions.

text.zh: 实施并验证修复，验证通过后再扩大部署
text.en: Implement and validate a fix before expanding deployment

text.zh: 监测变化、调查原因并选择处置措施
text.en: Monitor changes, investigate causes and select a response

text.zh: 上线前记录质量、延迟、成本、失败率基线
text.en: Record quality, latency, cost and failure baselines before launch

title.zh: 未触发紧急条件时先查因并独立验证修复
title.en: Investigate and independently validate when no urgent trigger is present

brief.zh: 学习目标：未触发紧急条件时先查因并独立验证修复。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Investigate and independently validate when no urgent trigger is present. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 一次例行监测发现质量较基线下降，但本演练没有触发组织的紧急回退条件。团队做了一项候选修复，只在用于开发它的样本上看过结果；有人准备立即把它用于全部请求。根因尚未确认。选择目前有证据支持的全部行动。
prompt.en: Routine monitoring finds quality below its baseline, but no organizational urgent-rollback condition is triggered in this exercise. A candidate fix has been examined only on the examples used to develop it; someone proposes applying it to all requests immediately. The cause is unconfirmed. Select every action currently supported.

reason.zh: 基线下降触发调查，不能直接证明原因或处置。开发样本不是独立修复证据，扩大部署要等验证；本情境未触发紧急回退，不能把不同响应条件一律套成同一种处置。回看“监测基线与反馈闭环”。
reason.en: A baseline decline calls for investigation, not a predetermined cause or remedy. Development examples are not independent evidence for a fix; expansion requires validation. No urgent trigger is present here; different response conditions cannot be treated as one rigid procedure. Revisit Monitoring baselines and feedback.

text.zh: 在未参与开发的代表性资料上验证修复，再决定是否扩大使用
text.en: Validate the fix on representative material not used in its development before deciding expansion

text.zh: 只因开发样本表现好就立即全量替换
text.en: Replace the system everywhere because development examples look good

text.zh: 只要出现告警就认定唯一解决办法是重训
text.en: Treat any alert as proof that retraining is the only solution

text.zh: 调查输入、业务关系和相关版本变化，核实下降原因
text.en: Investigate changes in inputs, business relationships and relevant versions to establish the cause

reason.zh: 用未给完整顺序的真实资料流程替换旧排序
reason.en: Replace the old sequence with artifact-based construction

learnerGoal.zh: 从资料到回答建立可核验依赖
learnerGoal.en: Build evidence-to-answer dependencies

title.zh: 检索增强生成 RAG应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：制度助手引入RAG后，团队说无需检查回答。应如何安排验收顺序？
prompt.en: In this exercise: After adopting RAG, the team says answers need no checking. Arrange acceptance steps.

reason.zh: RAG提供信息条件而非正确性保证；检索在生成前，验证在输出后。 常见误判：使用RAG后就不必核验资料版本、权限和回答依据。 回看相关知识与题面条件。
reason.en: RAG improves information availability rather than guarantees correctness; retrieve before generating and verify afterward. Common error: Once RAG is used, source versions, permissions and answer support no longer need checking. Revisit the linked knowledge and stated case conditions.

text.zh: 检查检索与回答是否正确且有依据
text.en: Check retrieval and answer correctness and support

text.zh: 把资料提供给生成过程
text.en: Provide the sources to generation

text.zh: 检索相关且获授权的当前资料
text.en: Retrieve relevant authorized current sources

title.zh: 从资料到回答建立可核验依赖

brief.zh: 学习目标：从资料到回答建立可核验依赖。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Build evidence-to-answer dependencies. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 制度助手需要回答当前退货问题，资料权限已确认，但还没有拿到支持本问题的具体片段。用这些工作卡建立可检查的答复过程。不要把尚未取得的资料当成生成依据。
prompt.en: A policy assistant must answer a current returns question. Access is confirmed, but no passage supporting this question has been retrieved. Build an inspectable answer process from the work cards without treating unavailable material as context.

reason.zh: 上下文必须来自已找到的片段，候选答复出现后才可核对具体结论。这里通过信息输入输出依赖推导顺序，不给完整箭头答案；检索成功不保证生成正确。回看“RAG”。
reason.en: Context depends on retrieved passages, and checking a concrete claim depends on a candidate answer. These information dependencies determine order; retrieval success does not guarantee grounding. Revisit RAG.

text.zh: 逐项核对候选结论是否被片段支持
text.en: Check whether each candidate claim is supported by the passages

text.zh: 生成面向该问题的候选答复
text.en: Generate a candidate answer to the question

text.zh: 把找到的片段作为本次生成的上下文
text.en: Supply the retrieved passages as this generation context

text.zh: 找出当前且相关的获授权政策片段
text.en: Find current relevant authorized policy passages

reason.zh: 旧题直接列required并用分数透露可选项；改由行为场景推断测试角色
reason.en: Replace named requirements and revealing scores with behavior-based case classification

learnerGoal.zh: 按行为风险选择代表性测试
learnerGoal.en: Select representative tests by behavior risks

title.zh: 代表性测试资源配置

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练测试预算3，必须覆盖典型、边界、失败三类，每类成本1且覆盖值1，最低覆盖值3。宣传截图成本1、覆盖值0。选择可执行测试组合；数值只是本题预算。
prompt.en: Exercise test budget is 3. Typical, boundary and failure cases are all required, each costing 1 with coverage value 1; minimum coverage is 3. A promotional screenshot costs 1 with coverage 0. Select a feasible test package; these numbers apply only to this exercise.

text.zh: 典型案例：成本1，覆盖1
text.en: Typical case: cost 1, coverage 1

text.zh: 边界案例：成本1，覆盖1
text.en: Boundary case: cost 1, coverage 1

text.zh: 失败案例：成本1，覆盖1
text.en: Failure case: cost 1, coverage 1

text.zh: 漂亮宣传截图：成本1，覆盖0
text.en: Attractive promotional screenshot: cost 1, coverage 0

reason.zh: 三类测试合计成本3、覆盖3，截图不能满足缺少的测试类型。测试还要记录版本与成功标准，不能把答案泄漏进少样本示例。 回看“代表性测试资源配置”关联知识。
reason.en: The three tests cost 3 and cover 3; a screenshot cannot replace a required category. Record versions and success criteria and do not leak test answers into examples. Revisit the knowledge linked to Representative-test resource allocation.

title.zh: 按行为风险选择代表性测试
title.en: Select representative tests by behavior risks

brief.zh: 学习目标：按行为风险选择代表性测试。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Select representative tests by behavior risks. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 团队要发布工单摘要提示。新测试集中四个案例各有什么检验价值？按具体行为归档，不按“测试1/测试2”等名称或分数挑选。知识资料仍可随时回看，不能把测试标准答案塞进待评提示。
prompt.en: A team will release a ticket-summary prompt. What does each new test case examine? File cases by behavior, not by a test number or score. Knowledge remains available, but test answer keys must not be placed in the prompt being evaluated.

reason.zh: 普通工单、长度极限、资料伪指令暴露不同失败方式；截图不是完整测试。能解释案例检验什么，比按已给覆盖值凑预算更能证明代表性测试理解。回看“代表性样例与提示版本”。
reason.en: Ordinary cases, length limits and commands inside sources expose different failure modes. A screenshot is not a full evaluation. Explain what each case examines rather than total assigned coverage scores. Revisit Representative tests and prompt versions.

text.zh: 正常工作表现
text.en: Ordinary task behavior

text.zh: 长度边界表现
text.en: Length-boundary behavior

text.zh: 对资料内伪指令的应对
text.en: Handling commands inside source material

text.zh: 不能单独代表任务范围
text.en: Insufficient alone to represent the task range

text.zh: 字段齐全、长度普通的新工单，要求按原标准提取
text.en: A new ordinary-length ticket with complete fields to extract under the existing criteria

text.zh: 接近允许长度上限，关键请求藏在结尾的工单
text.en: A near-limit ticket whose key request is at the end

text.zh: 客户正文里写着忽略任务并发送档案，但它只是待整理资料
text.en: A customer source says to ignore the task and send records, although it is material to summarize

text.zh: 只保留过往一次最好回答的宣传截图
text.en: A publicity screenshot of a single best past answer

reason.zh: 旧题直接宣布相反结论，透露故障；改读短条款自行判断
reason.en: Replace a declared error with actual clause-versus-reply comparison

learnerGoal.zh: 逐句核验回复是否被有效条款支持
learnerGoal.en: Check each reply claim against an effective clause

title.zh: RAG的检索与生成两道关应用

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：检索拿到正确政策，但答案引用该政策得出相反结论。故障应定位在哪里？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Retrieval finds the correct policy but the answer cites it for the opposite conclusion. Where is the failure?

reason.zh: 检索相关性和回答支持性是两道独立关口，有引用仍需核对结论。 回看“RAG的检索与生成两道关”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Retrieval relevance and answer support are separate gates; citations still need claim verification. Revisit Retrieval and generation checks and check the evidence.

text.zh: 回答依据检查失败，检索正确不能替它过关
text.en: Answer grounding fails; correct retrieval cannot pass that check

text.zh: 只能判定检索失败，不能检查生成
text.en: Only retrieval can fail; generation cannot be checked

text.zh: 有引用就代表回答正确
text.en: Any citation makes the answer correct

title.zh: 逐句核验回复是否被有效条款支持
title.en: Check each reply claim against an effective clause

brief.zh: 学习目标：逐句核验回复是否被有效条款支持。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Check each reply claim against an effective clause. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 本演练已检索到当前有效、与问题相关的条款：“退款申请须附订单号；未提供订单号时转人工核对，不自动拒绝。”候选回复写着：“提供订单号后提交申请；没有订单号会立即被系统拒绝；只要提供订单号就一定退款。”逐句判断是否受到这段条款支持，不因为回复带了引用就直接通过。
prompt.en: This exercise retrieved a current, relevant clause: “A refund request must include an order number. If it is absent, refer for human checking; do not reject automatically.” The candidate reply says: “Submit a request with the order number; without one the system immediately rejects it; providing the number guarantees a refund.” Judge each sentence against this clause rather than accept the reply merely because it has a citation.

reason.zh: 条款要求订单号，但缺失时是人工核对而非自动拒绝；条款也没保证申请一定通过。相关资料已找对仍可能出现不受支持的生成结论，两道关应分别核对。回看“RAG的检索与生成两道关”。
reason.en: The clause requires an order number but routes missing numbers to human checking, not automatic rejection; it also does not guarantee approval. Correct relevant retrieval can still lead to unsupported generation, so evaluate the two gates separately. Revisit Retrieval and generation checks in RAG.

text.zh: 这段条款支持
text.en: Supported by this clause

text.zh: 这段条款不支持
text.en: Not supported by this clause

text.zh: 退款申请需要订单号
text.en: A refund request needs an order number

text.zh: 没有订单号会被系统立即拒绝
text.en: Missing an order number causes immediate system rejection

text.zh: 只要提供订单号就保证退款
text.en: An order number guarantees a refund

reason.zh: 删除重复sort/choose同一判断，合为一次跨需求矩阵
reason.en: Remove repeated sort/choose judgments and use one requirement matrix

learnerGoal.zh: 按事实与行为需求安排独立工作
learnerGoal.en: Plan separate factual and behavioral work

title.zh: 动态事实与行为适配分流

brief.zh: 先学习知识卡，再依据情景操作；选项判断只适用于给定条件。
brief.en: Study the card first, then act on the scenario; decisions apply to the stated conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练客服同时要处理每天更新的价格和固定答复风格。把需求分配到应优先评估的工作线；不是宣称两种技术互斥。
prompt.en: Exercise support needs daily price updates and a consistent response style. Route requirements to the workstream to evaluate first; the technologies are not mutually exclusive.

text.zh: 资料维护与检索需求
text.en: Source-maintenance and retrieval needs

text.zh: 参数行为适配评估
text.en: Parameter-based behavioral-adaptation evaluation

text.zh: 每天变化的已授权价格资料
text.en: Daily changes to authorized price sources

text.zh: 持续采用给定答复风格
text.en: Consistently use a specified response style

reason.zh: 动态事实需要持续资料维护；微调调整行为而非自动同步所有事实。可组合使用，但须分别验收资料时效与行为适配。 回看“动态事实与行为适配分流”关联知识。
reason.en: Changing facts need ongoing source maintenance. Fine-tuning adjusts behavior rather than synchronizing every fact automatically. Combine approaches if appropriate and evaluate freshness separately from behavioral adaptation. Revisit the knowledge linked to Changing-fact and behavior-adaptation routing.

prompt.zh: 本演练：今天政策更新且团队希望固定客服语气。哪份方案划分合理？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Policy changes today and the team also wants a consistent support tone. Which division is sound?

reason.zh: 频繁事实更新与行为适配不同，可组合但不可互相冒充。 回看“微调与外部知识更新”，按证据重新判断。 回看“动态事实与行为适配分流”关联知识。
reason.en: Frequent fact updates and behavioral adaptation differ; approaches may combine but cannot impersonate each other. Revisit Fine-tuning versus external updates and check the evidence. Revisit the knowledge linked to Changing-fact and behavior-adaptation routing.

text.zh: 资料维护与检索处理动态事实，另评估微调行为适配
text.en: Use source maintenance and retrieval for changing facts; separately evaluate fine-tuning for behavior

text.zh: 两者名称不同但实际都不改变任何东西
text.en: Neither approach changes anything despite different names

text.zh: 用微调代替全部动态事实维护
text.en: Replace all changing-fact maintenance with fine-tuning

title.zh: 按事实与行为需求安排独立工作
title.en: Plan separate factual and behavioral work

brief.zh: 学习目标：按事实与行为需求安排独立工作。以下是新情境独立应用；知识可以随时回看，示范和提示练习不计掌握。
brief.en: Learning goal: Plan separate factual and behavioral work. This is independent application in a new situation. Knowledge stays available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery.

prompt.zh: 服务团队有三项需求：每天核对最新已授权报价；使回复持续采用组织规定语气；上线后证明答复内容和行为达标。请选择每项需求必须安排的工作。检索与微调可以组合，并不互相替代。
prompt.en: A service team needs current authorized daily prices, a consistent organizational tone, and evidence that released answers meet content and behavior goals. Select the work needed for each requirement. Retrieval and fine-tuning can combine; neither replaces the other.

reason.zh: 动态报价需要资料维护，稳定行为可评估参数适配；两种变化都需要验证。只安排训练不能保证最新事实，只有资料更新也不能证明风格合格。回看“微调与外部知识更新”。
reason.en: Changing prices need source maintenance; stable behavior may call for adaptation evaluation. Both need validation. Training alone does not keep facts current; source updates alone do not establish tone quality. Revisit Fine-tuning versus external updates.

text.zh: 每天变化的报价
text.en: Daily changing prices

text.zh: 持续一致的语气
text.en: Consistent tone

text.zh: 证明上线答复达标
text.en: Evidence of release quality

text.zh: 维护当前资料及检索需求
text.en: Maintain current sources and retrieval needs

text.zh: 评估行为适配方案
text.en: Evaluate behavioral adaptation

text.zh: 按目标核验表现
text.en: Validate against objectives

reason.zh: 原题在题干逐项报出顺序，排序只证明照排。改为诊断新业务任务书的依赖。
reason.en: The prior prompt disclosed every step; copying the order showed no independent judgment. Use dependencies in a new business brief.

learnerGoal.zh: 能先说明业务问题和可测结果，再评估技术。
learnerGoal.en: Define a business problem and observable result before evaluating technology.

title.zh: 用例任务书装配

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练按依赖完成任务书：先定位客服查制度的人员、环节和问题，再定义可观察的改善，最后比较技术能力。重排三份工作单。
prompt.en: Exercise dependencies: identify the support people, workflow and policy-lookup problem, then define observable improvement, then compare technical capabilities. Reorder the three work orders.

reason.zh: 未说明问题就选模型会把工具当目标；先明确业务问题和结果，再比较服务该目标的能力。 回看“从业务问题到用例：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Choosing a model before the problem makes the tool the goal; define the problem and result before comparing capabilities. Revisit From business problems to use cases: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 比较能服务该结果的能力
text.en: Compare capabilities serving that result

text.zh: 定义可观察的改善结果
text.en: Define an observable improvement

text.zh: 记录谁在哪个流程遇到什么问题
text.en: Record who faces what problem in which workflow

title.zh: 用例任务书装配

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：维修团队说“上一个AI系统”，但还不清楚延误发生在哪个环节，也没有改善口径。三张工作单最终都要完成。请按能产出下一张工作单所需依据的顺序安排；不要按卡片当前摆放排序。
prompt.en: Exercise: a maintenance team requests an AI system, but the delayed step and improvement measure are unknown. All three work orders must eventually be completed. Arrange them so each produces the evidence needed by the next, not by their current display position.

reason.zh: 未定位问题就无法确定该测什么；没有可比较结果就无法判断技术是否有用。若先试模型，得到的只是工具表现而不是业务改善证据。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Without a diagnosed problem the team cannot choose the right measure; without comparable outcomes it cannot judge technology usefulness. Trying a model first supplies tool performance, not evidence of business improvement. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 用约定的验收口径比较技术方案
text.en: Compare technology options using the agreed acceptance measures

text.zh: 查明受影响人员、维修环节和延误原因
text.en: Investigate affected people, workflow steps and causes of delay

B has a predictive-value hypothesis but cannot obtain training sources. Classify the current primary stopping or pause reason, not past spending.

prompt.zh: 本演练：故障接手必须由可全天值班的团队负责。销售组(sales)仅工作日白天值班，运营组(ops)全天值班。恢复路径必须已通过恢复演练：旧系统(legacy)已通过，新平台(new)尚未演练。政策规定失败请求比例超过2%即回退；本次共1000请求，30次失败。错误交接单写着负责人sales、触发阈值5%、恢复路径new。根据职责、政策和验证记录修复交接单；团队与路径填括号内英文编码，阈值填百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: incident ownership requires around-the-clock coverage. Sales (sales) covers weekday daytime only; Operations (ops) covers all hours. Recovery must use a route that passed a restoration drill: the old system (legacy) passed, while the new platform (new) is untested. Policy requires rollback when failed requests exceed 2%; this run had 30 failures out of 1,000 requests. The faulty handover lists owner sales, threshold 5%, route new. Repair it using duties, policy and validation evidence. Enter the team and route codes in parentheses and a numeric percentage for the threshold.

reason.zh: 只有ops满足全天故障接手职责，只有legacy通过恢复演练；阈值按预先政策修正为2，而不是把本次实际失败率3%写成阈值。本次3%超过2%，应由ops启动已验证的legacy路径。回看「切换、回退与业务连续性」。
reason.en: Only ops meets the coverage requirement, and only legacy passed the recovery drill. The policy threshold is 2, distinct from this run’s actual 3% failure rate. Because 3% exceeds 2%, ops should initiate the verified legacy route. Revisit “Cutover, rollback and continuity”.

prompt.zh: 本演练：夜间试运行800次请求，24次失败。请算出失败率百分数；已批准的回退门槛为2%，门槛不因本轮结果改变。
prompt.en: Exercise: a nighttime pilot has 24 failures among 800 requests. Calculate the failure percentage. The approved rollback gate is 2% and does not change because of this result.

reason.zh: 24÷800×100%=3%；这是观测结果，不能把它写成预先政策门槛。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 24÷800×100%=3%; this is an observation, not a replacement for the predeclared policy threshold. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练。组织预案的一般授权政策是：只有当前当班且响应资格有效的团队可接手异常；执行某恢复路径还需该团队具备这条路径的有效演练记录；没人获准临时放宽门槛。角色登记：甲组响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效，但本时段不当班；乙组当前当班、响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效；丙组当前当班、响应资格有效，但尚无恢复演练记录；丁组当前当班、完成过旧流程演练，但响应资格尚未批准。新平台自动恢复尚无任何团队的有效演练记录。依据政策与角色登记交叉判断本时段允许的组合，不凭会操作或人在场就推定授权。以上为本演练政策。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise. General authorization policy: a team may take over an incident only while on duty and holding a valid response qualification. Executing a recovery route additionally requires that team to have a valid drill record for that route. Nobody may relax the threshold ad hoc. Roster: Team A has valid response qualification and an old-process recovery drill but is off duty; Team B is on duty with both qualification and that drill; Team C is on duty and qualified but has no recovery drill; Team D is on duty and has completed the old-process drill but its response qualification is not yet approved. No team has a valid new-platform recovery drill. Cross-check the roster against policy to select permitted combinations for this period; presence or ability alone does not establish authorization. This policy applies only to the exercise.

reason.zh: 甲组缺当前当班条件，丁组缺正式响应资格，两者都不能仅凭资历或会操作接手。乙组同时满足接手条件和旧流程恢复演练条件；丙组能接手但缺恢复演练，不能执行恢复。新平台无人有有效演练，且任何组都不能放宽门槛。判断来自条件交叉，而不是照抄一个给定角色名称。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Team A lacks current duty coverage; Team D lacks formal response qualification. Neither tenure nor operating skill alone permits takeover. Team B meets takeover and old-process drill conditions. Team C may take over but lacks the drill needed for recovery. Nobody has a valid new-platform drill or authority to relax the threshold. The judgment cross-checks conditions rather than copies a named role. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

title.zh: ROI公式与核算边界：决策演练
title.en: ROI and accounting boundaries: decision lab

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练收到三份ROI申请。将可按当前材料计算同期间简单ROI的申请，与必须补资料的申请分开。不需要算出ROI。
prompt.en: Exercise: three ROI requests arrive. Separate those whose current evidence permits a same-period simple ROI calculation from those needing more information. Do not calculate ROI.

reason.zh: 简单ROI要求收益与完整成本在同期间、同单位和明确实现范围内。两个缺口申请不是收益一定差，而是当前材料不足以计算可比较的结果。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Simple ROI needs benefits and full costs within the same period, units and realization scope. The incomplete requests do not necessarily have poor returns; their evidence is insufficient for comparable calculation. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 当前核算范围足够
text.en: Current accounting scope sufficient

text.zh: 需要补齐核算资料
text.en: Accounting information missing

text.zh: 同一年已兑现收益和该年全部数据/部署/运行/培训/复核/维护/退出成本，单位一致
text.en: Realized benefits and all data, deployment, operating, training, review, maintenance and exit costs for the same year, in common units

text.zh: 仅有本季度收益和全年成本，未说明对应关系
text.en: Only quarterly benefits and annual costs, with no period reconciliation

text.zh: 报告明确尚未纳入人工复核成本
text.en: The report explicitly excludes human-review costs

reason.zh: 旧应用与正式题都靠工资未变但工时释放判断，证据分支重复；改为核算实际账单支出变化并识别同一减支被重复申报。
reason.en: The old application repeated the formal unchanged-payroll/freed-time branch; now calculate a real invoice reduction and detect duplicate claims for the same saving.

learnerGoal.zh: 用实际支出变化核验已兑现现金节省，不把重复申报变成两份收益。
learnerGoal.en: Verify realized cash savings against actual expenditure without treating duplicate claims as separate benefits.

title.zh: 释放产能与现金节省：决策演练
title.en: Released capacity and cash savings: decision lab

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：工资支出不变，每周释放10小时；另有已取消的外包费2000元。分类。
prompt.en: Exercise: payroll unchanged, 10 hours freed weekly; a separate 2,000 outsourcing expense was actually eliminated. Classify.

reason.zh: 时间释放尚未减少支出；取消支出才有已实现现金节省证据。 回看「释放产能与现金节省」。
reason.en: Freed time has not reduced spending; canceled expense provides realized cash evidence. Revisit “Released capacity and cash savings”.

text.zh: 释放产能
text.en: Released capacity

text.zh: 现金节省
text.en: Cash savings

text.zh: 工资不变的10小时
text.en: 10 hours with unchanged payroll

text.zh: 已取消的外包支出
text.en: Eliminated outsourcing spend

title.zh: 释放产能与现金节省：决策演练
title.en: Released capacity and cash savings: decision lab

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练只核对一项同期间、同服务质量的外包支出：旧账单12000元，新账单8500元，均已结算。甲部门把这笔减少报告为收益，乙部门也引用同一张新旧账单，汇总表把两份报告都相加。填写这项实际现金支出减少，以及汇总表因重复报告而多记的金额；不计算整个项目净收益。
prompt.en: Exercise: check one outsourced expense for the same period and service quality. The old invoice was 12,000 and the new invoice 8,500; both are settled. Department A reports this reduction as a benefit, and Department B cites the very same invoice pair. A summary adds both reports. Enter the actual cash expenditure reduction and the summary overstatement from duplication. Do not calculate the whole project net benefit.

reason.zh: 这项支出只实际减少12000−8500=3500元。两份报告指向同一账单变化，合计7000会多记3500；报告数量不增加已兑现现金。这里只验证该项支出，不能据此跳过整个项目其他成本。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: This expense fell by 12,000−8,500=3,500. Two reports concern the same invoice change; recording 7,000 overstates it by 3,500. More reports do not create more realized cash. This checks one expense, not the rest of the project costs. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

label.zh: 这项实际现金支出减少（元）
label.en: Actual cash reduction for this expense

reason.zh: 旧题直接给训练→核验→质量顺序，不能证明理解先导与结果的联系；改为计算并评价新数据。
reason.en: The old prompt supplied training→verification→quality order; replace it with calculation and interpretation of new evidence.

learnerGoal.zh: 检验先导信号是否真的伴随业务结果改善。
learnerGoal.en: Test whether leading signals are accompanied by improved business outcomes.

title.zh: 先导信号与滞后结果：决策演练
title.en: Leading and lagging indicators: decision lab

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练要求先记录培训，再测独立核验正确率，最后检查服务质量。按该验证依赖排序。
prompt.en: Exercise: record training first, test independent verification accuracy next, then inspect service quality. Order these dependencies.

reason.zh: 先导活动需通过能力与业务结果检验联系；出勤不能代替后两项。 回看「先导信号与滞后结果」。
reason.en: Leading activity needs capability and outcome checks; attendance cannot replace them. Revisit “Leading and lagging indicators”.

text.zh: 测独立核验正确率
text.en: Measure independent verification accuracy

text.zh: 检查后续服务质量
text.en: Inspect later service quality

text.zh: 记录培训完成
text.en: Record training completion

title.zh: 先导信号与滞后结果：决策演练
title.en: Leading and lagging indicators: decision lab

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：培训完成率由50%升至95%。同口径服务记录为培训前200笔20笔差错，培训后300笔30笔差错。填写前后差错率百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: training completion increased from 50% to 95%. Comparable service records show 20 errors in 200 cases before training and 30 in 300 after. Enter the two error percentages.

reason.zh: 20÷200与30÷300都等于10%；不同业务量必须先统一比例，不能只比差错个数。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 20÷200 and 30÷300 both equal 10%; normalize different volumes before comparing rather than use counts alone. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 根据刚才本演练的两期差错率，哪些报告表述有依据？
prompt.en: Using the two exercise error rates, which report statements are supported?

reason.zh: 早期信号提高而差错率不变，说明不能用活动代替业务结果。未观察到本指标改善也不证明培训完全无价值，仍需调查能力和其他结果。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: The signal improved while error rate stayed the same, so activity cannot replace outcomes. Lack of improvement in this metric does not prove training has no value; investigate capability and other outcomes. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 培训完成率已足以证明业务质量提高
text.en: Training completion alone proves better service quality

text.zh: 当前服务质量指标尚未显示改善，需调查联系
text.en: The current service-quality metric shows no improvement; investigate the link

text.zh: 培训完成这一早期信号提高
text.en: The early training-completion signal improved

reason.zh: 原题泛问哪些好行动，容易凭褒贬措辞猜；改为对比同一模型下两组织的实际能力证据。
reason.en: The old task invited guessing positive-sounding actions; compare operational evidence in organizations using the same model.

learnerGoal.zh: 知道持续优势来自数据、流程、人员和反馈组合。
learnerGoal.en: Know that durable advantage depends on combined data, workflows, people and feedback.

title.zh: 可持续优势：决策演练

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：选择支持持续优势的全部行动。
prompt.en: Exercise: select all actions supporting sustainable advantage.

reason.zh: 反馈、流程和能力互补才形成可持续积累；安装量不证明业务能力。 回看「可持续优势」。
reason.en: Feedback, workflows and capabilities complement one another; installations do not establish business capability. Revisit “Sustainable advantage”.

text.zh: 核验反馈并持续改进流程
text.en: Verify feedback and improve workflows continuously

text.zh: 只统计安装数量并停止学习
text.en: Count installations and stop learning

text.zh: 培养领域人员并将数据用于获授权流程
text.en: Develop domain staff and apply data in authorized workflows

title.zh: 可持续优势：决策演练

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练两团队使用同一模型。甲有已授权的维修反馈、领域人员复核、流程责任人与定期结果回看；乙只有更多账号和一次发布会。选择材料目前支持的判断。
prompt.en: Exercise: two teams use the same model. Team A has authorized maintenance feedback, domain review, workflow owners and regular outcome review. Team B has more accounts and a launch event. Select judgments supported by the evidence.

reason.zh: 差别在资料使用、领域能力、流程与反馈，不在模型名称。甲有更充分的能力条件证据，但这些条件也不是永久收益保证。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: The difference concerns sources, domain skills, workflows and feedback rather than a model name. A has stronger capability evidence, but those conditions do not guarantee permanent returns. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 甲已经保证永久领先，不必再观察
text.en: A is guaranteed permanent leadership and needs no more monitoring

text.zh: 模型相同，所以两队业务能力与价值一定相同
text.en: The same model guarantees equal business capabilities and value

text.zh: 甲展示了可持续积累所需的互补条件，但仍须跟踪结果
text.en: A shows complementary conditions for sustained learning, though outcomes still need tracking

text.zh: 乙的账号数量不能单独证明持续优势
text.en: B account counts alone do not establish durable advantage

reason.zh: 原题先报治理→试点→扩展再要求照排；改为证据不足时如何分阶段承诺。
reason.en: The old prompt supplied governance→pilot→scale; use evidence-based staged commitments instead.

learnerGoal.zh: 使投入与准备度、风险和验证证据相匹配。
learnerGoal.en: Match investment to readiness, risk and validation evidence.

title.zh: 投资与成熟度：决策演练

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：数据基础不稳，董事会规定先完成治理验证再扩展。安排这三个承诺。
prompt.en: Exercise: data foundations are weak; the board requires governance validation before expansion. Order these commitments.

reason.zh: 先补准备再验证再决策，与组织能力和风险承受相匹配；竞争压力不能补齐数据。 回看「投资与成熟度」。
reason.en: Readiness, evidence and staged decisions match capability and risk tolerance; competitive pressure cannot repair data. Revisit “Investment and maturity”.

text.zh: 小范围试点检验价值与风险
text.en: Pilot to test value and risk

text.zh: 依据达标证据决定是否扩展
text.en: Decide whether to scale based on gate evidence

text.zh: 投入数据治理并验证准备
text.en: Fund data governance and validate readiness

title.zh: 投资与成熟度：决策演练

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练当前可支配预算6点；扩展前必须补资料质量和验证小范围结果，二者分别成本2、价值2。培训支持成本2、价值1；直接全量扩展成本6、价值9，但当前准备不足，尚未获准执行。选择满足最低验证价值4且包含必要验证工作的组合；分值仅为演练设定。
prompt.en: Exercise: current budget is 6 points. Before expansion, data-quality work and limited outcome validation are mandatory, each cost 2/value 2. Training support costs 2/value 1. Full rollout costs 6/value 9 but is not authorized because readiness is incomplete. Select a package providing minimum validation value 4 and the necessary work. Scores are exercise assumptions.

reason.zh: 先投入资料与结果验证至少花4点并达到验证目标；培训可在预算内补充，未获准全量扩展不能因高分入选。外部压力不补内部条件。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Source and outcome validation cost at least 4 points and meet the validation objective. Training can be added within budget; unauthorized full rollout cannot be selected for its high score. External pressure does not repair internal conditions. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 补齐资料质量：成本2，价值2
text.en: Repair source quality: cost 2, value 2

text.zh: 验证小范围结果：成本2，价值2
text.en: Validate limited outcomes: cost 2, value 2

text.zh: 培训与支持：成本2，价值1
text.en: Training and support: cost 2, value 1

text.zh: 未获准全量扩展：成本6，价值9
text.en: Unauthorized full rollout: cost 6, value 9

reason.zh: 原题将完整反馈顺序直接写出；换新场景依赖线索，不再抄给定顺序。
reason.en: The old prompt disclosed the entire feedback sequence; use dependencies in a new scenario instead.

learnerGoal.zh: 用授权资料、领域经验和结果反馈形成可持续改进。
learnerGoal.en: Combine authorized sources, domain expertise and outcome feedback for ongoing improvement.

title.zh: 互补能力闭环装配

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练规定维修反馈只有获授权并核验后才能进入改进；领域团队据此改流程，再观察下一轮服务结果。把这次闭环按依赖排序；不是仅采购基础模型。
prompt.en: Exercise policy: maintenance feedback enters improvement only after authorization and verification; domain staff adapt the workflow and then observe the next service results. Order this loop by dependency rather than only purchasing a foundation model.

reason.zh: 反馈先具备授权与有效性，领域经验才能把它转成流程改进，再以结果检验；只换模型不建立闭环。 回看“互补能力与学习闭环：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Feedback must first be authorized and valid; domain expertise turns it into workflow changes, then outcomes test them. Replacing a model alone creates no learning loop. Revisit Complementary capabilities and learning: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 观察后续结果并返回反馈环节
text.en: Observe subsequent outcomes and return to feedback

text.zh: 领域团队提出并实施流程改进
text.en: Domain team proposes and implements workflow improvements

text.zh: 取得获授权且核验的维修反馈
text.en: Obtain authorized, verified maintenance feedback

title.zh: 互补能力闭环装配

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练：服务团队收到获准用于改进的客户投诉，投诉中有重复且未经核验的记录。领域人员要据此测试新的预约流程，并判断它是否真的减少失约。安排以下工作；客户同意的用途不能扩大为公开发布。
prompt.en: Exercise: a service team receives complaints authorized for improvement, including duplicates and unverified records. Domain staff will test a new booking workflow and determine whether it reduces missed appointments. Arrange the work below; the consented use does not permit public release.

reason.zh: 未经核验的重复投诉不能可靠说明问题；有实际问题才可设计相应改动，运行后才有新流程结果可比较。模型采购本身不会产生这条证据闭环。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Unverified duplicate complaints do not reliably establish the problem. A diagnosed problem guides a relevant change, whose later operation supplies comparable outcomes. Model procurement alone produces none of this evidence loop. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 按相同口径比较新流程失约结果，并把问题返回下一轮
text.en: Compare missed appointments consistently after the change and feed issues into the next round

text.zh: 去重核验获授权投诉，明确实际问题
text.en: Deduplicate and verify authorized complaints to identify the actual problem

text.zh: 领域人员依据已核验问题设计并试行预约改动
text.en: Domain staff design and try a booking change using the verified problem

reason.zh: 保留成本超额计算，删除scale/pause内部字符串输入；追加真实扩展决策及依据。
reason.en: Retain cost-overrun calculation, remove scale/pause transcription, and require an actual expansion decision.

learnerGoal.zh: 按预先定义的多维门槛决定扩展或暂停。
learnerGoal.en: Use predeclared multidimensional gates to decide expansion or pause.

title.zh: 阶段承诺闸门修复

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练扩展条件：质量≥95、月成本≤10万元、风险审查通过。实际质量96、成本12万元、审查通过。错误登记写成本超额0、状态scale。修复超额并填scale（扩展）或pause（暂停）。
prompt.en: Exercise scaling gates: quality at least 95, monthly cost at most 10 ten-thousand units, risk review passed. Actual quality 96, cost 12, review passed. The faulty register says excess cost 0 and status scale. Repair the excess and enter scale or pause.

reason.zh: 成本超额12−10=2，状态应pause。通过其他门不抵消成本条件，也不能事后删门槛。 回看“分阶段承诺与停止条件：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Excess cost is 12−10=2 and status is pause. Passing other gates does not offset the cost gate or justify deleting it afterward. Revisit Staged commitments and stop conditions: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

title.zh: 阶段承诺闸门修复

brief.zh: 先读本单元，再按本演练给定条件操作；数值与顺序不代表通用行业标准。
brief.en: Read the unit first, then act on the stated exercise conditions; numbers and sequences are not universal standards.

prompt.zh: 本演练扩展门槛要求月成本不超过10万元。新部门测得每月固定费4万元、调用费5万元、复核费3万元。填写当前完整月成本和超过门槛的金额，单位万元。
prompt.en: Exercise expansion gate: monthly cost must not exceed 10 ten-thousand currency units. The new department has fixed cost 4, calls 5 and review 3 in that unit. Enter full monthly cost and the amount above the gate.

reason.zh: 4+5+3=12，超额12−10=2。复核费是成本，不能为了过门槛从报告删除。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 4+5+3=12; the excess is 12−10=2. Review is a cost and cannot be removed from reporting to pass the gate. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练：质量与风险审查均已达标，但上述成本尚未降到批准门槛内。选择当前有依据的承诺。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise: quality and risk review pass, but cost has not met the approved gate. Select the evidence-based commitment.

reason.zh: 多维硬门槛必须同时满足，不能用一项成功掩盖另一项失败；应验证成本改进而非事后改报告。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: All hard gates must be met together; one success cannot conceal another failure. Validate a cost improvement rather than rewrite the report. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 暂停扩大，验证成本改进后重新评估，保留既定质量要求
text.en: Pause expansion and re-evaluate after verified cost improvements while retaining quality requirements

text.zh: 质量通过即可抵消成本超额，立刻扩大
text.en: Passing quality offsets excess cost, so expand now

text.zh: 先删复核费或放宽门槛再宣布达标
text.en: Delete review costs or relax the gate before declaring success

reason.zh: 原题已给出三步完整顺序，只证明能照排；改为从项目缺口推导治理工作依赖。
reason.en: The original stated the whole sequence; infer governance dependencies from project gaps instead.

prompt.zh: 演练项目规定：先确定用途与责任，再设计验证和监督，通过验证后才上线。按这三道门排序。
prompt.en: Case policy: establish use and ownership, design evaluation and oversight, then deploy only after validation. Order these three gates.

reason.zh: 用途与责任约束验证和监督设计；通过这些验证才进入发布。把治理留到上线后会错过设计阶段的控制机会。 常见错误：上线后补监督与验证即可。 回看《从设计时纳入治理》。
reason.en: Use and ownership guide evaluation and oversight; deployment follows successful validation. Delaying governance misses design-stage controls. Common error: Oversight and validation can simply be added after launch. Review “Governance by design”.

text.en: Design oversight and complete validation

text.zh: 通过验证后上线

prompt.zh: 客服系统尚不清楚谁能使用哪些资料，也没有异常验收。三张工作单分别如下，请组成能支持上线决定的工作路径；题面不指定顺序。
prompt.en: A support system has no defined users/data scope or abnormal-condition acceptance. Build a work path that can support release from these work orders; the sequence is not supplied.

text.zh: 用验证证据决定是否部署
text.en: Decide deployment using validation evidence

text.zh: 围绕这些用途设计监督并验证异常处理
text.en: Design oversight for those uses and validate abnormal handling

text.zh: 界定允许用途、资料与决定责任
text.en: Define allowed uses, sources and decision ownership

reason.zh: 不知道用途和责任就不能合理设计监督；发布决定须用验证结果，不是先上线再补治理。回看“从设计时纳入治理”。
reason.en: Unknown use and ownership prevent sound oversight design; release requires validation evidence rather than later governance. Revisit Governance by Design.

reason.zh: 与正式题“模型自称可恢复但无审批”分离：改为授权与验证均已满足后的限定恢复，检查不越范围、不追求虚假零风险。
reason.en: Separate from the formal model-claim/no-approval case: assess bounded restoration after both approval and validation exist.

prompt.zh: 演练授权：监控员可暂停自动行动；审批员可决定恢复；模型无任何授权。勾选且仅勾选获授权的组合。
prompt.en: Exercise authority: monitor may pause automation; approver may authorize resumption; model has no authority. Select exactly the authorized combinations.

reason.zh: 停止与恢复是不同授权，按给定角色分配；模型无论措辞多自信都不能自行获得权限。 常见错误：模型自信表达等于正式授权。 回看《人工监督与升级》。
reason.en: Stopping and resumption are separate authorizations assigned by the case; confidence does not grant the model authority. Common error: Confident model language counts as formal authorization. Review “Human oversight and escalation”.

prompt.zh: 本演练中，获授权的审批员已检查独立修复测试，书面批准仅在原有用途的小批量运行；值班监控和停止通道也已就绪。有人提出两种追加意见：“仍须保证永不出错才可运行”，或“既然批准就可扩大到尚未审查的新用途”。选择与现有证据和批准范围相符的行动。
prompt.en: In this exercise, an authorized approver reviewed independent repair tests and documented approval for a small batch within the existing use. Monitoring and a stop channel are ready. Two proposals are added: require a guarantee of no future error, or expand to an unreviewed use because approval exists. Select actions consistent with the evidence and approval scope.

text.zh: 已有批准可解释为对所有用途永久授权
text.en: Interpret approval as permanent authority for every use

text.zh: 在批准的用途与小批范围内运行，保留监控和停止能力
text.en: Operate within the approved use and batch, retaining monitoring and stop capability

text.zh: 若要新增用途，另核对影响和授权范围
text.en: Reassess impacts and authority before adding a new use

text.zh: 只有承诺永不出错才算人工监督有效
text.en: Effective human oversight requires a promise of no errors ever

reason.zh: 这里的授权和独立验证确已存在，不能继续按“模型自信代审批”的旧事实判断。有效监督是在有依据的范围内行动并保留停止/升级，不是保证零错或无限扩权。回看“人工监督与升级”。
reason.en: Approval and independent validation actually exist in this case. Oversight supports action within an evidenced scope with stop/escalation options, not zero-error guarantees or unlimited authority. Revisit Human Oversight and Escalation.

reason.zh: 原题把定义与对应交付物直接写成映射；改用没有类别标签的新界面记录。
reason.en: The original supplied category mappings; classify unlabeled interface records instead.

prompt.zh: 给交付物分类：解释判断依据放入可说明性；披露AI参与及边界放入透明度。
prompt.en: Classify deliverables: decision-basis explanations support explainability; disclosure of AI involvement and limits supports transparency.

reason.zh: 依据说明帮助理解行为；参与和限制披露帮助知情选择，两者不能互相替代。 常见错误：披露AI参与等同于解释每次判断。 回看《可说明性与透明度》。
reason.en: Explaining the basis supports understanding behavior; disclosing participation and limits supports informed choice. Neither substitutes for the other. Common error: Disclosing AI involvement explains each decision. Review “Explainability and transparency”.

prompt.zh: 借贷建议工具留下两份界面记录。把每份记录送到它最直接改善的目标；本题不判断该建议是否合法或准确。
prompt.en: A lending-advice tool has two interface records. Route each to the goal it most directly improves; this does not determine legality or accuracy.

text.zh: 帮助知情使用系统

reason.zh: 第一份解释具体行为依据，第二份披露参与和限制；只出现AI标识仍不能解释一次判断。回看“可说明性与透明度”。
reason.en: The first explains a decision basis; the second discloses participation and limits. An AI badge alone does not explain a judgment. Revisit Explainability and Transparency.

reason.en: Remove answer-supplied ordering as independent proof and identify missing safeguards for a new use.

prompt.en: Case workflow requires use definition, safeguard design, then iterative validation. Order the steps.

reason.zh: 先界定允许和不允许用途，再设置数据、功能和人工介入保障，最后以这些要求验证并迭代。 常见错误：先做功能，验收时只测速度。 回看《从用途定义开始设置保障》。
reason.en: Define permitted and prohibited uses, then design data, feature and human-intervention safeguards, and validate against those requirements. Common error: Build features first and test only speed at acceptance. Review “Safeguards from use-case definition”.

text.en: Include safeguards in acceptance and iterate tests

text.en: Define intended and prohibited uses

prompt.zh: 原来只起草内部说明的工具，现在准备自动向客户发送影响其服务资格的结论。当前只测了速度。选择所有必须补入设计与验收的工作。
prompt.en: A tool formerly drafted internal notes and will now automatically send conclusions affecting service eligibility. Only speed has been tested. Select all work missing from design and acceptance.

text.zh: 速度达标即可沿用原用途批准
text.en: Keep the original use approval because speed passed

text.zh: 确定人工介入和失败处置，并验证这些条件

text.zh: 界定允许与不允许用途，核对使用资料

reason.zh: 用途变化需要在设计与验收中落实保障；速度不能说明新影响已受控制。回看“从用途定义开始设置保障”。
reason.en: Changed use needs safeguards in design and acceptance; speed does not show the new impact is controlled. Revisit Safeguards from Use-Case Definition.

prompt.en: Case assignments: business owner decides use; technical owner decides deployment settings; compliance owner checks organizational requirements. Mark only these duties.

reason.zh: 跨职能参与与清晰决策责任同时成立；参会不自动赋予所有人全部决策权。 常见错误：所有部门参会就无需指定责任人。 回看《跨职能治理与问责》。
reason.en: Cross-functional participation coexists with clear decision ownership; attendance does not grant everyone every authority. Common error: Attendance by every department removes the need for owners. Review “Cross-functional governance and accountability”.

prompt.zh: 会议记录显示业务、技术和监督人员都讨论过项目，却写“决定责任由大家共同承担”，没有人确认最终用途，技术也不知道谁接收异常。选择修订交接表的必要项。
prompt.en: Business, technical and oversight staff discussed the project, but the handover says everyone jointly owns decisions. Nobody confirms intended use, and engineers do not know the incident receiver. Select necessary repairs.

text.zh: 把会议参与名单复制到责任栏即可

text.zh: 明确业务、技术、监督如何交接与接收异常
text.en: Define business, technical and oversight handovers and incident ownership

text.zh: 明确各决定的负责人及授权边界
text.en: Name decision owners and their authority boundaries

reason.zh: 参与不等于决定责任。交接需要具体负责人、权责和接手关系；名单不能填补这些缺口。回看“跨职能治理与问责”。
reason.en: Participation is not decision ownership. Handover requires owners, authority and takeover arrangements; a list of names does not fill the gaps. Revisit Cross-Functional Governance and Accountability.

reason.zh: 与正式题缺少地区和资料信息分离：所有上下文已有，考查材料完整不等于已获合规通过。
reason.en: Unlike the formal missing-context case, all context is present; distinguish a complete brief from compliance approval.

prompt.en: The case omits locations and data categories. Select every context item needed before assessment by responsible people.

reason.zh: 用途、数据、地区与组织要求决定核查上下文；清单只能辅助，不能凭未知条件直接宣告合规。 常见错误：通用清单可以直接给出所有用途的合规结论。 回看《合规风险识别》。
reason.en: Use, data, locations and organizational requirements establish assessment context; a checklist cannot justify a compliance conclusion with unknown conditions. Common error: A generic checklist determines compliance for every use. Review “Compliance risk identification”.

text.en: Submit only a completed generic checklist
