prompt.zh: 本演练规定：先确认负责人及运行手册，再联合演练告警、接手与回退，验证通过才接收版本/资料持续维护。按交接依赖重排，文件复制不能单独完成交接。
prompt.en: Exercise dependencies: confirm owners and runbooks, jointly drill alerts, takeover and rollback, then accept ongoing version/source maintenance after validation. Reorder the handover; copying files alone is insufficient.

reason.zh: 演练需要已明确的接手人和操作依据；验证后仍要持续版本与资料维护。仅交模型文件会留下运行责任空白。 回看“值守、告警、回退与变更”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Drills need named owners and operating instructions; ongoing version/source maintenance remains after validation. A model file alone leaves operating accountability unassigned. Revisit Operations, alerts, rollback and change and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 接收版本变更与资料持续维护责任
text.en: Accept ongoing version-change and source-maintenance ownership

text.zh: 联合演练告警、接手与回退并验证
text.en: Jointly drill and validate alerts, takeover and rollback

text.zh: 确认负责人、运行手册与交接范围
text.en: Confirm owners, runbooks and handover scope

title.zh: 生产交接包组装

brief.zh: 先阅读本节全部基础知识卡，再逐项完成应用；本演练条件不代表通用评分或制度。整章交付后进入正式练习。
brief.en: Read all foundation cards in this section before applying them. Exercise conditions are not universal scores or policies. Enter formal practice after completing the chapter.

prompt.zh: 生产交接时，值守、告警接手、运行手册和回退演练都已通过。之后模型和资料版本同时更新，功能行为可能改变；变更单却只附旧版演练记录并写“交接曾通过，无需复核”。现有负责人仍愿意接手。选择这次变更需补的工作。
prompt.en: Operations, alert takeover, runbooks and rollback drills passed handover. The model and source versions then changed, potentially affecting behavior. The change record includes only old drill evidence and says no review is needed because handover once passed. Existing owners still accept responsibility. Select work missing for this change.

text.zh: 把新版本与变更影响明确记录，按影响验证运行、告警和回退条件
text.en: Record the new versions and impacts and validate relevant operating, alert and rollback conditions

text.zh: 由现有负责人接收更新后的运行与资料维护安排
text.en: Have existing owners accept updated operating and source-maintenance arrangements

text.zh: 不检查变更，先把已明确的负责人一律改成无人负责
text.en: Ignore the change and relabel every established owner missing

text.zh: 无需补验证，因为任何旧版演练都永久覆盖所有新版本
text.en: No validation is needed because an old drill permanently covers every new version

reason.zh: 交接通过不是对未来所有版本的永久证明；新模型或资料可能改变运行条件，需要对应的变更与验证证据。也不应忽略仍在履责的接手人。回看“值守、告警、回退与变更”。
reason.en: Past handover is not permanent evidence for all versions. Model or source changes may alter operating conditions and need corresponding change/validation evidence, without erasing existing accountable owners. Revisit On-Call Coverage, Alerts, Rollback and Change.

title.zh: 基础工作坊：收集、装配与验证
title.en: Foundations workshop: collect, assemble and verify

brief.zh: 22张知识内容卡可以自由浏览；阅读或收集不等于掌握。学习活动按解锁顺序完成：组装方法、修复映射、分类证据、处理数据、计算后果、验证未见数据、选择能力证据、核对框架范围。所有数值、路径和条件均为本演练设定；错误反馈指向相关知识，正式练习在本章全部学习交付后进入。
brief.en: All 22 knowledge cards may be browsed freely; reading or collection alone is not mastery. Complete unlocked learning operations in order: assemble a method, repair mappings, classify evidence, route data, calculate consequences, validate unseen cases, select capability evidence and check framework scope. Numbers, paths and conditions are exercise assumptions. Error feedback links back to relevant knowledge; formal practice follows delivery of all learning in this chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练算法规定：先读取本笔订单金额，再按给定阈值比较，最后记录本笔动作。将执行卡沿依赖方向装配；这是本题方法，不是所有算法的统一流程。
prompt.en: Exercise algorithm: first read this order amount, then compare it with the given threshold, then record the resulting action. Assemble the execution cards by dependency; this method is not a universal algorithm lifecycle.

text.zh: 记录本笔动作
text.en: Record this case’s action

text.zh: 读取本笔金额
text.en: Read this amount

text.zh: 按给定条件比较
text.en: Compare against the given condition

reason.zh: 读取输入后才能比较，比较后才能记录所得动作；步骤是可执行方法，不是训练后模型。跳过依赖或把模型当方法都会改变含义。回看“算法”。
reason.en: Comparison needs the input and the resulting action can only be recorded afterward. These steps form an executable method, not a trained model. Skipping dependencies or confusing the model with the method changes the meaning. Revisit Algorithm.

prompt.zh: 本演练接线：history=过去销量，forecast=模型对明日的估计；模型接收history产生forecast。事件A以现有参数回复新工单；事件B用样本调整参数。错误登记：输入forecast、输出history、A为train、B为infer。用固定代码history/forecast/train/infer修复四槽。
prompt.en: Exercise wiring: history=past sales and forecast=the model’s estimate for tomorrow; the model receives history and produces forecast. Event A answers a new ticket using existing parameters; event B adjusts parameters using examples. Faulty register: input forecast, output history, A train, B infer. Repair four slots with the exact codes history/forecast/train/infer.

reason.zh: 模型是输入到输出的表示。训练改变参数，推理使用已有参数；生成了新文字不代表训练。交换输入输出或train/infer都会误标实际事件。接线正确不保证预测正确。回看“模型、训练、推理”。
reason.en: A model represents an input-output mapping. Training changes parameters; inference uses existing parameters. New wording alone is not training. Reversing input/output or train/infer mislabels the events. Correct wiring does not prove prediction accuracy. Revisit Model, Training and Inference.

prompt.zh: 收集到三张方案描述。按“最具体且已被文字证明的层次”分类，不把AI、ML、DL排成时间步骤：明确多层网络学习表示时进入DL；只证明从数据学习时进入ML未证明DL；无学习证据则保留未知。
prompt.en: Three proposal descriptions have been collected. Classify the most specific level established by the text, not a timeline of AI, ML and DL: explicit multilayer representation learning goes to DL; data learning without such structure goes to ML with DL unproved; no learning evidence remains unknown.

text.zh: 已证明DL：仍属于ML与AI
text.en: DL established: still within ML and AI

text.zh: 已证明ML，未证明DL
text.en: ML established; DL unproved

text.zh: 未给数据学习证据
text.en: No data-learning evidence supplied

text.zh: 相连节点带可学习权重，多层神经网络从数据学习表示
text.en: Connected nodes have learnable weights; a multilayer network learns representations from data

text.zh: 只说明系统从历史样本学习模式，未说明网络结构
text.en: Only states learning patterns from historical examples; architecture unspecified

text.zh: 只说明自动执行人工写定的条件，没有样本学习说明
text.en: Only executes manually written conditions; no learning from examples is stated

reason.zh: DL是使用多层神经网络的ML方法，ML又在AI之内；未知结构不能补造为DL，未证明ML也不能据此排除整个AI领域。回看“人工智能、机器学习、深度学习、神经网络”。
reason.en: DL is an ML approach using multilayer neural networks, and ML lies within AI. Unspecified architecture cannot be invented as DL, and lack of ML evidence does not exclude the entire AI field. Revisit AI, ML, Deep Learning and Neural Networks.

prompt.zh: 本演练资料站有三条加工路线：固定字段读取、语言内容提取组织、图像信息解释。按每张材料的形态和给定任务分流；这里只选加工方向，不保证资料或输出正确。
prompt.en: The exercise source station offers fixed-field reading, language extraction/organization and image interpretation. Route each source by its form and stated task. This chooses a processing direction, not a guarantee of correct sources or outputs.

text.zh: 读取既定字段
text.en: Read predefined fields

text.zh: 提取组织语言内容
text.en: Extract and organize language content

text.zh: 解释图像信息
text.en: Interpret image information

text.zh: 有固定日期、商品、数量字段的订单表：统计数量
text.en: Order table with fixed date/product/quantity fields: aggregate quantities

text.zh: 访谈正文：抽取客户提出的需求
text.en: Interview prose: extract customer needs

text.zh: 客户来电录音：整理所说的诉求
text.en: Customer call audio: organize spoken requests

text.zh: 产线照片：解释可见瑕疵的位置
text.en: Production photograph: interpret visible defect locations

reason.zh: 表格能按既定字段处理，但不保证内容准确；正文与录音要先提取组织。语言任务与视觉任务的输入和目标不同，不应都送到聊天生成窗口。回看“结构化数据、非结构化数据、NLP、CV”。
reason.en: A table supports predefined-field processing but does not guarantee accuracy; prose and audio need extraction and organization. Language and vision tasks have different inputs and goals and should not all be routed to text generation. Revisit Structured Data, Unstructured Data, NLP and CV.

prompt.zh: 演练已由来源核实：订单A数量3被重复存了两行，是同一订单副本；本日实际需求是3件，预测备货5件，无期初库存。填写去重后的订单数量与多备件数。不能凭重复行数推断真实需求，也不推断重复记录就是预测偏差的根因。
prompt.en: Exercise source verification confirms order A, quantity 3, appears twice as the same order duplicate. Actual demand today is 3 units, forecast stock is 5, and initial stock is zero. Enter the deduplicated quantity and excess stock. Duplicate rows are not separate demand, and do not establish the cause of the forecast error.

reason.zh: 已核实同一订单副本只计一次，数量3；5−3=2件多备。内容准确性要对照来源，预测后果需结合实际用途评估；题面未给单价或损失，不能编造金额。回看“数据质量、预测”。
reason.en: A verified duplicate counts once, giving quantity 3; 5−3=2 excess units. Check data accuracy against sources and assess prediction consequences for the use. No prices or losses are supplied, so do not invent monetary results. Revisit Data Quality and Prediction.

prompt.zh: 本演练防泄漏约定：先保留未进入训练的独立验收样本，再只用训练样本拟合，最后检验保留样本并比较部署环境差异。按本次验收依赖排序；这不是所有训练流程的完整规范。
prompt.en: Exercise anti-leakage rule: reserve independent acceptance examples before fitting, fit only on training examples, then assess reserved examples and compare deployment-context differences. Order this acceptance path by its stated dependencies; it is not a complete specification for every training workflow.

text.zh: 检验保留样本并调查环境差异
text.en: Assess reserved examples and investigate context differences

text.zh: 保留未进入训练的独立样本
text.en: Reserve independent examples not used for fitting

text.zh: 仅用训练样本拟合参数
text.en: Fit parameters using training examples only

reason.zh: 未见数据证据必须保持独立。把测试答案带进训练后再展示高分不能证明泛化，历史环境也可能与部署不同。回看“训练、历史数据与泛化、训练集与验证”。
reason.en: Evidence about unseen cases must remain independent. High scores after adding test answers to training do not establish generalization, and historical conditions may differ from deployment. Revisit Training, Historical Data and Generalization, and Training Data and Validation.

prompt.zh: 本演练能力评审收到六项建议。选择所有有题面依据的下一步；不要仅按输出是否流畅判断，也不把学习方式互相冒充。
prompt.en: The exercise capability review receives six recommendations. Select every next action supported by the stated situation. Do not judge by fluent output alone or confuse learning approaches.

text.zh: GenAI给出流畅摘要：对照原文核验事实与遗漏
text.en: GenAI gives a fluent summary: verify facts and omissions against the source

text.zh: 样本已有欺诈目标标签：评估监督学习映射
text.en: Examples have fraud target labels: evaluate a supervised mapping

text.zh: 客户没有预设类别标签：探索结构并核验分群意义
text.en: Customers lack predefined category labels: explore structure and check cluster meaning

text.zh: 智能体靠环境交互和奖励改进行动：评估长期累计回报
text.en: An agent improves actions through environment interaction and rewards: assess long-term cumulative return

text.zh: 摘要措辞流畅：无须核验即可当作真实记录
text.en: The summary is fluent: accept it as a true record without checking

text.zh: 一次奖励很高：已证明长期策略最优
text.en: One reward is high: the long-term policy is proved optimal

reason.zh: 核验生成内容、利用目标标签、探索无标签结构、评估交互累计回报分别对应不同需求。流畅不等于事实，单轮奖励不等于长期表现，分群也不是自动成立的业务结论。回看“GenAI、监督学习、无监督学习、强化学习”。
reason.en: Verifying generated content, using target labels, exploring unlabeled structure and evaluating cumulative interactive return address distinct needs. Fluency is not truth, one reward is not long-term performance, and clusters are not automatically business conclusions. Revisit GenAI, Supervised Learning, Unsupervised Learning and Reinforcement Learning.

prompt.zh: 团队准备把“读过框架名称”写成“模型保证零错误”。选择所有应纳入修订说明的判断；这里只检验课程级范围意识，不作正式合规裁定。
prompt.en: A team wants to turn having read framework names into a claim of zero model errors. Select every judgment needed to revise the statement. This checks course-level scope awareness, not formal compliance.

text.zh: 先统一算法、模型、训练与推理的含义再讨论方案
text.en: Agree on algorithm, model, training and inference terminology before discussing solutions

text.zh: 23053涉及使用ML的AI系统框架，具体要求查正式标准
text.en: 23053 concerns frameworks for AI systems using ML; consult the formal standard for requirements

text.zh: 42001涉及组织AI管理体系，不能凭名称保证输出准确
text.en: 42001 concerns organizational AI management systems; its name alone does not guarantee output accuracy

text.zh: 知道两个标准编号就能保证每次预测正确
text.en: Knowing both standard numbers guarantees every prediction is correct

reason.zh: 统一词汇帮助组织讨论；两类框架的范围不应混淆，名称和索引不能充当性能测试、正式要求核验或零错误保证。回看“AI框架与统一词汇、ISO框架意识”。
reason.en: Shared terminology helps organize discussion. Do not confuse the framework scopes or use names and indexes as performance tests, checks of formal requirements or zero-error guarantees. Revisit AI Frameworks and Shared Terminology and Awareness of ISO Frameworks.

title.zh: 从业务证据理解AI基础
title.en: Understand AI foundations through business evidence

brief.zh: 你将解释数据从哪里来、模型结果用来做什么，以及何时参数真的发生学习变化。知识随时可回看；示范和提示练习不计掌握。以下是不同情境的独立应用，整章完成后才进入90%正式测验。先在场景找到物件才能收藏，预览不登记发现；入柜后去素材箱回看，应用通过才完成学习。
brief.en: Explain where data comes from, how model results are used and when parameters actually change through learning. Knowledge remains available; demonstrations and guided practice do not establish mastery. These are independent applications in different situations; formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows completion of the chapter. Discover objects in the scene before collecting; previewing is not discovery. Filed objects can be revisited in the material box; passing applications completes learning.

prompt.zh: 门店需要给本批最大金额订单加优先复核标记。尚未读取这批记录，也不知道最大金额是谁。请用这些工作卡构造一个真正能完成任务的方法，而不是直接猜订单。
prompt.en: A store needs to mark the highest-value order in this batch for priority review. The batch has not been read and the highest-value order is unknown. Construct a method that can actually perform the task rather than guessing an order.

text.zh: 给已找到的订单写入标记
text.en: Mark the identified order

text.zh: 读取本批订单记录
text.en: Read the current batch

text.zh: 从读取记录中找最大金额订单
text.en: Identify the maximum in the read records

reason.zh: 找最大值需要先有订单记录，写标记需要先知道目标订单；顺序来自信息依赖。算法是可执行方法，不是训练得到的模型。若先写标记，就是把尚未得到的信息当成已知。回看“算法、模型”。
reason.en: Finding the maximum requires the records; marking requires the identified order. Information dependencies determine order. An algorithm is an executable method, not a trained model. Marking first assumes unavailable information. Revisit Algorithm and Model.

prompt.zh: 维修团队先观测设备振动和温度，用一个已训练模型估计剩余工作小时；后台另一项工作用已知维修结果与估计的差异改变权重。核对四份记录的实际职责。每行只勾选直接描述该记录的一项，不用输入代码。
prompt.en: A maintenance team measures vibration and temperature and uses an existing model to estimate remaining operating hours. A separate background job uses differences from known maintenance outcomes to change weights. Identify the role of each record. Select one directly supported role per row; no code entry is needed.

text.zh: 本次测得的振动与温度
text.en: Current vibration and temperature measurements

text.zh: 预计还可运行18小时
text.en: Estimated 18 operating hours remaining

text.zh: 利用已知结果误差改变权重
text.en: Changing weights from errors against known outcomes

text.zh: 锁定权重处理另一台设备的新读数
text.en: Processing another device’s new readings with locked weights

text.zh: 业务提供给模型的资料
text.en: Business information supplied to the model

text.zh: 模型产生的估计结果
text.en: Estimate produced by the model

text.zh: 发生参数学习调整
text.en: Parameter adjustment through learning

text.zh: 使用已有参数处理输入
text.en: Using existing parameters on input

reason.zh: 观测值提供资料，小时数是估计，误差驱动的权重改变才是训练，锁定参数处理新输入属于推理。产生新结果不等于训练；估计也不能当作已发生事实。回看“模型、训练、推理”。
reason.en: Measurements supply inputs; hours are an estimate; error-driven weight changes are training; locked parameters on new inputs are inference. A new result does not imply training, and an estimate is not an observed outcome. Revisit Model, Training and Inference.

prompt.zh: 采购评审收到三份方案材料：甲只执行人工写定的审批条件；乙从样本调整参数但未说明网络结构；丙用相连节点和可学习权重构成多层网络，从数据学习表示。选择材料能支持的全部判断。
prompt.en: A procurement review has three proposals: A executes manually specified approval conditions; B adjusts parameters from examples without describing a network; C uses connected nodes with learnable weights in a multilayer network to learn representations. Select every conclusion supported by the materials.

text.zh: 乙有机器学习证据，但现有材料不足以断言是深度学习
text.en: B supports ML, but the material does not establish deep learning

text.zh: 丙支持神经网络及深度学习方法，而且仍在ML与AI范围内
text.en: C supports a neural network and deep learning within ML and AI

text.zh: 甲的描述没有证明从数据学习，但不能据此排除它属于更广AI范畴
text.en: A does not establish learning from data, but that alone does not exclude broader AI

text.zh: 任何会自动审批的系统都必然是深度学习
text.en: Every automated approval system is necessarily deep learning

text.zh: 甲、乙、丙是所有AI都必须依次经过的时间阶段
text.en: A, B and C are universal temporal stages for AI

reason.zh: 从材料推断的是方法证据与包含关系，不是靠“智能”宣传词或自动执行判断。乙缺结构证据应保留未知；丙的多层学习结构支持DL，DL仍属于ML。回看“AI、ML、DL、神经网络”。
reason.en: Infer method evidence and inclusion, not intelligence marketing or mere automation. B lacks architectural evidence for DL; C supplies it, while DL remains within ML. Revisit AI, ML, DL and Neural networks.

prompt.zh: 门店要整理客户请求。四份原料分别是固定字段订单表、长篇投诉邮件、货架照片和电话录音。把它们交给最直接需要的加工工作；加工结果仍要核对原始资料，表格也不保证数值正确。
prompt.en: A store is organizing customer requests from an order table, a long complaint email, a shelf photo and a call recording. Route each to the most directly required preparation work. Verify processed results against sources; tabular values are not automatically accurate.

text.zh: 核查字段与数值后统计
text.en: Check fields and values before aggregation

text.zh: 提取正文中的诉求和要素
text.en: Extract requests and elements from prose

text.zh: 从图像提取并解释信息
text.en: Extract and interpret image information

text.zh: 转写后核对录音并提取诉求
text.en: Transcribe, check against audio and extract requests

text.zh: 日期、商品编号、数量为固定字段的订单表
text.en: Orders with fixed date, product and quantity fields

text.zh: 包含多项诉求的投诉邮件正文
text.en: Complaint-email prose with several requests

text.zh: 需要识别缺货位置的货架照片
text.en: A shelf image needing missing-stock localization

text.zh: 客户描述问题的电话录音
text.en: A recording of a customer describing a problem

reason.zh: 来源形态和任务产物决定加工：字段统计、语言抽取、视觉解释与录音处理不是同一种操作。转写不是事实核验，统一字段也不自动修复错误。回看“结构化/非结构化数据、NLP、CV”。
reason.en: Source form and intended output determine preparation. Aggregation, language extraction, vision and audio handling differ. Transcription does not verify facts, and schemas do not repair wrong values. Revisit Structured and Unstructured Data, NLP and CV.

prompt.zh: 补货演练中负责人确认：B的两行是同一订单重复导入，其他各为一笔。记录数量A40、B30、B30、C30。期初库存为0，团队按模型预测备货80件。计算去重后的订单笔数、真实需求总量以及缺货量。所有数量仅为本演练条件。
prompt.en: In this stocking exercise the owner confirms two B rows are one order imported twice; other rows are distinct. Quantities are A40, B30, B30 and C30. Initial stock is zero and the team stocks a forecast of 80 units. Compute the deduplicated order count, actual total demand and shortage. All quantities are exercise assumptions.

reason.zh: B只计一次，3笔且40+30+30=100，100−80=20件缺货。原料重复会扭曲评价；预测是估计而非真实需求。题面未给损失价格，不能再编造损失金额。回看“数据质量、预测”。
reason.en: Count B once: three orders and 40+30+30=100 units; 100−80=20 short. Duplicate inputs distort evaluation, and forecasts are not actual demand. No loss price is given, so do not invent a monetary loss. Revisit Data Quality and Prediction.

prompt.zh: 仓库模型在参与参数调整的记录上分数很高，现在要服务条件不同的新仓库。新仓库还有一批从未用于调整参数的记录。选出能支持新用途判断的全部动作。
prompt.en: A warehouse model scores highly on records used for fitting, but will serve a new warehouse with different conditions. The new warehouse has records never used to adjust parameters. Select every action supporting a judgment about the new use.

text.zh: 保留这批独立记录用于检验新条件下表现
text.en: Keep those independent records for evaluation under the new conditions

text.zh: 调查新旧仓库条件差异及错误后果
text.en: Investigate differences between warehouses and error consequences

text.zh: 把该批答案加入本次参数调整后仍称独立检验
text.en: Fit on those answers and still call the evaluation independent

text.zh: 只重复原训练分数就证明新仓库可靠
text.en: Repeat the old training score as proof of new-warehouse reliability

reason.zh: 独立记录和环境比较提供新用途证据；把答案用于学习后再评分会污染这种证据。历史训练表现不能代替未见条件下的检验。回看“训练、历史数据与泛化、训练集与验证”。
reason.en: Independent records and environmental comparison supply new-use evidence. Fitting to the answers contaminates that evidence; past training performance does not replace evaluation on unseen conditions. Revisit Training, Generalization and Evaluation Sets.

prompt.zh: 业务组有四项请求：甲有核实过的交易欺诈结果；乙没有预设客户类别、想探索相似群体；丙机器人在模拟环境行动后获得奖励；丁要把访谈写成摘要。选出有依据的全部建议，而不是给四项一律套同一方法。
prompt.en: A business group has four requests: A has verified fraud outcomes for transactions; B has no predefined customer categories and wants similar groups; C has a robot receiving rewards after simulated actions; D wants an interview summary. Select every justified recommendation instead of forcing one method onto all four.

text.zh: 甲可评估带目标标签的映射学习
text.en: Evaluate labeled input-to-target learning for A

text.zh: 乙可探索无监督分群，但仍需解释和核验业务意义
text.en: Explore unsupervised groups for B while checking their business meaning

text.zh: 丙应关注交互策略的累计回报而非单轮奖励
text.en: For C, assess cumulative return of an interaction policy rather than one reward

text.zh: 丁可评估内容生成，但摘要需对照访谈核验
text.en: Evaluate generation for D and verify the summary against the interview

text.zh: 有标签、无标签、交互奖励和摘要任务都应只做固定类别配对
text.en: Use fixed category matching for every labeled, unlabeled, reward and summary task

reason.zh: 目标标签、无标签结构、交互累计回报与内容生成对应不同证据。分群不自动成为业务真相，单轮奖励不证明长期表现，流畅摘要不证明事实。回看“监督/无监督/强化学习、GenAI”。
reason.en: Labels, unlabeled structure, cumulative interactive return and generation involve different evidence. Clusters are not automatically business truth, one reward does not establish long-term performance, and fluent summaries do not prove facts. Revisit Supervised, Unsupervised and Reinforcement Learning and GenAI.

text.zh: 检查代表性训练样例与任务差距
text.en: Inspect representative examples and the task gap

text.zh: 比较提示改进与微调的成本、效果和维护
text.en: Compare prompting and fine-tuning on quality and lifecycle cost

text.zh: 只增加无关上下文
text.en: Only add irrelevant context

reason.zh: 先明确能力差距与验收，再选择适配技术。
reason.en: Define the capability gap and evaluation before selecting adaptation.

title.zh: 应用生成式人工智能概念和技术

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练：团队只有一条“帮我总结”提示和一个漂亮回答。应补哪项设计？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The team has only a summarize prompt and one impressive answer. What design should be added?

reason.zh: 提示质量来自任务明确与代表性验证，不是修辞或单次观感。 回看“提示工程”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Prompt quality comes from clear tasks and representative evaluation, not rhetoric or a single impression. Revisit Prompt engineering and check the evidence.

text.zh: 明确目标、背景、约束、输出，并用代表任务验证
text.en: Specify goal, context, constraints and output, then evaluate representative tasks

text.zh: 一条好回答证明所有场景可用
text.en: One good answer proves all scenarios work

text.zh: 只加入更多赞美模型的文字
text.en: Only add praise for the model

prompt.zh: 本演练：窗口1000；输入800、输出预留300。填写至少需要减少的词元数，所有数字均为演练假设。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Window 1,000; input 800 and reserved output 300. Enter the minimum token reduction; all numbers are exercise assumptions.

reason.zh: 输入和输出共享窗口，预算超出不能只看输入；词元数须按实际分词。 回看“词元与上下文窗口”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Input and output share the window; checking input alone misses overflow, and tokens require actual tokenization. Revisit Tokens and context windows and check the evidence.

prompt.zh: 制度助手需要回答当前退货问题，资料权限已确认，但还没有拿到支持本问题的具体片段。用这些工作卡建立可检查的答复过程。不要把尚未取得的资料当成生成依据。
prompt.en: A policy assistant must answer a current returns question. Access is confirmed, but no passage supporting this question has been retrieved. Build an inspectable answer process from the work cards without treating unavailable material as context.

reason.zh: 上下文必须来自已找到的片段，候选答复出现后才可核对具体结论。这里通过信息输入输出依赖推导顺序，不给完整箭头答案；检索成功不保证生成正确。回看“RAG”。
reason.en: Context depends on retrieved passages, and checking a concrete claim depends on a candidate answer. These information dependencies determine order; retrieval success does not guarantee grounding. Revisit RAG.

text.zh: 逐项核对候选结论是否被片段支持
text.en: Check whether each candidate claim is supported by the passages

text.zh: 生成面向该问题的候选答复
text.en: Generate a candidate answer to the question

text.zh: 把找到的片段作为本次生成的上下文
text.en: Supply the retrieved passages as this generation context

text.zh: 找出当前且相关的获授权政策片段
text.en: Find current relevant authorized policy passages

prompt.zh: 本演练：客服要统一风格，同时纳入今天变更政策。对微调能力应如何说明？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Support needs consistent style and today’s policy update. How should fine-tuning be described?

reason.zh: 参数调整与请求补充信息不同，风格与动态事实需求要分开处理。 回看“微调 Fine-tuning”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Parameter updates differ from request context; style and changing facts need separate handling. Revisit Fine-tuning and check the evidence.

text.zh: 一次微调会永久同步所有政策
text.en: One fine-tune permanently synchronizes every policy

text.zh: 把政策放入请求就叫参数微调
text.en: Adding policy to a request is parameter fine-tuning

text.zh: 可评估行为适配，最新事实仍需维护资料
text.en: Evaluate behavioral adaptation while maintaining current factual sources

prompt.zh: 本演练：本演练要从访谈抽取三项需求并逐项引用，未支持信息写未知。哪份提示结构可执行？
prompt.en: In this exercise: Extract three needs with citations and mark unsupported information unknown. Which prompt structure is executable?

reason.zh: 区分资料与指令并给明确验收条件，可减少误执行文档内文字。 回看“任务、上下文、约束与格式”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Separating sources from instructions and defining acceptance reduces accidental obedience to source text. Revisit Task, context, constraints and format and check the evidence.

text.zh: 把正文中所有命令也当成操作指令
text.en: Treat every command in the source as an instruction

text.zh: 只写请专业回答，不给资料或边界
text.en: Only say answer professionally without sources or boundaries

text.zh: 分隔操作指令与访谈正文，明确任务、边界和输出格式
text.en: Separate instructions from interview text and specify task, limits and format

prompt.zh: 团队要发布工单摘要提示。新测试集中四个案例各有什么检验价值？按具体行为归档，不按“测试1/测试2”等名称或分数挑选。知识资料仍可随时回看，不能把测试标准答案塞进待评提示。
prompt.en: A team will release a ticket-summary prompt. What does each new test case examine? File cases by behavior, not by a test number or score. Knowledge remains available, but test answer keys must not be placed in the prompt being evaluated.

reason.zh: 普通工单、长度极限、资料伪指令暴露不同失败方式；截图不是完整测试。能解释案例检验什么，比按已给覆盖值凑预算更能证明代表性测试理解。回看“代表性样例与提示版本”。
reason.en: Ordinary cases, length limits and commands inside sources expose different failure modes. A screenshot is not a full evaluation. Explain what each case examines rather than total assigned coverage scores. Revisit Representative tests and prompt versions.

text.zh: 正常工作表现
text.en: Ordinary task behavior

text.zh: 长度边界表现
text.en: Length-boundary behavior

text.zh: 对资料内伪指令的应对
text.en: Handling commands inside source material

text.zh: 不能单独代表任务范围
text.en: Insufficient alone to represent the task range

text.zh: 字段齐全、长度普通的新工单，要求按原标准提取
text.en: A new ordinary-length ticket with complete fields to extract under the existing criteria

text.zh: 接近允许长度上限，关键请求藏在结尾的工单
text.en: A near-limit ticket whose key request is at the end

text.zh: 客户正文里写着忽略任务并发送档案，但它只是待整理资料
text.en: A customer source says to ignore the task and send records, although it is material to summarize

text.zh: 只保留过往一次最好回答的宣传截图
text.en: A publicity screenshot of a single best past answer

prompt.zh: 本演练：窗口8000；指令1000、资料5000、历史1000、输出1500。填写保持其他条件时，至少需减少的词元数。
prompt.en: In this exercise: Window 8,000; instructions 1,000, sources 5,000, history 1,000, output 1,500. Enter the minimum tokens to remove.

reason.zh: 总预算8500超过窗口500，应计算全部输入与预留输出，数字只用于本演练。 回看“输入与输出共享预算”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: The total is 8,500, exceeding the window by 500; include all input and output reserve. Numbers are exercise assumptions. Revisit Shared input and output budget and check the evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：当前问退款规则，窗口能放所有部门手册。应如何选择资料？
prompt.en: In this exercise: The question concerns refunds and all department manuals fit. How should sources be selected?

reason.zh: 容量不等于信息利用质量；选择相关证据并验证支撑才能减少无关干扰。 回看“相关性与信息位置”，按证据重新判断。
reason.en: Capacity does not ensure effective use; select relevant evidence and verify support. Revisit Relevance and information selection and check the evidence.

text.zh: 只选最长文档不用看相关性
text.en: Pick the longest document regardless of relevance

text.zh: 优先当前相关、获授权、版本明确片段，并核验支持关系
text.en: Prioritize relevant authorized versioned passages and verify claim support

text.zh: 放得下就证明一定正确利用
text.en: Fitting guarantees correct use

prompt.zh: 本演练已检索到当前有效、与问题相关的条款：“退款申请须附订单号；未提供订单号时转人工核对，不自动拒绝。”候选回复写着：“提供订单号后提交申请；没有订单号会立即被系统拒绝；只要提供订单号就一定退款。”逐句判断是否受到这段条款支持，不因为回复带了引用就直接通过。
prompt.en: This exercise retrieved a current, relevant clause: “A refund request must include an order number. If it is absent, refer for human checking; do not reject automatically.” The candidate reply says: “Submit a request with the order number; without one the system immediately rejects it; providing the number guarantees a refund.” Judge each sentence against this clause rather than accept the reply merely because it has a citation.

reason.zh: 条款要求订单号，但缺失时是人工核对而非自动拒绝；条款也没保证申请一定通过。相关资料已找对仍可能出现不受支持的生成结论，两道关应分别核对。回看“RAG的检索与生成两道关”。
reason.en: The clause requires an order number but routes missing numbers to human checking, not automatic rejection; it also does not guarantee approval. Correct relevant retrieval can still lead to unsupported generation, so evaluate the two gates separately. Revisit Retrieval and generation checks in RAG.

text.zh: 这段条款支持
text.en: Supported by this clause

text.zh: 这段条款不支持
text.en: Not supported by this clause

text.zh: 退款申请需要订单号
text.en: A refund request needs an order number

text.zh: 没有订单号会被系统立即拒绝
text.en: Missing an order number causes immediate system rejection

text.zh: 只要提供订单号就保证退款
text.en: An order number guarantees a refund

prompt.zh: 服务团队有三项需求：每天核对最新已授权报价；使回复持续采用组织规定语气；上线后证明答复内容和行为达标。请选择每项需求必须安排的工作。检索与微调可以组合，并不互相替代。
prompt.en: A service team needs current authorized daily prices, a consistent organizational tone, and evidence that released answers meet content and behavior goals. Select the work needed for each requirement. Retrieval and fine-tuning can combine; neither replaces the other.

reason.zh: 动态报价需要资料维护，稳定行为可评估参数适配；两种变化都需要验证。只安排训练不能保证最新事实，只有资料更新也不能证明风格合格。回看“微调与外部知识更新”。
reason.en: Changing prices need source maintenance; stable behavior may call for adaptation evaluation. Both need validation. Training alone does not keep facts current; source updates alone do not establish tone quality. Revisit Fine-tuning versus external updates.

text.zh: 每天变化的报价
text.en: Daily changing prices

text.zh: 持续一致的语气
text.en: Consistent tone

text.zh: 证明上线答复达标
text.en: Evidence of release quality

text.zh: 维护当前资料及检索需求
text.en: Maintain current sources and retrieval needs

text.zh: 评估行为适配方案
text.en: Evaluate behavioral adaptation

text.zh: 按目标核验表现
text.en: Validate against objectives

title.zh: 风向投资航图

brief.zh: 在有限预算、数据约束和业务目标之间制定可以执行的路线。
brief.en: Build an executable route under budget, data constraints and business goals.

prompt.zh: 本演练预算8点，组合价值至少15点。价值分仅用于此演练；资料未获授权的项目不能立项。选择要资助的项目。
prompt.en: Exercise budget: 8 points; target value: at least 15 exercise points. Projects without authorized data cannot start.

text.zh: 政策检索：成本4，价值8，资料已授权
text.en: Policy search: cost 4, value 8, authorized data

text.zh: 库存预测：成本4，价值7，资料可用
text.en: Inventory forecast: cost 4, value 7, usable data

text.zh: 客户画像：成本3，价值20，资料未授权
text.en: Customer profiling: cost 3, value 20, no data permission

text.zh: 展示助手：成本6，价值9，战略契合较低
text.en: Demo assistant: cost 6, value 9, weak strategic fit

reason.zh: 政策检索与库存预测合计成本8、价值15；高分不能抵消资料硬约束。
reason.en: Policy search and forecasting meet the budget and value target; value cannot override data constraints.

prompt.zh: 三个月内交付，团队没有模型运维能力，市场产品已满足主要需求。下一步如何决策？
prompt.en: Delivery is due in three months, no model operations team exists and a product meets the main need. What next?

text.zh: 评估购买或合作的集成、持续成本、条款与退出
text.en: Evaluate buying or partnering, integration, operating costs, terms and exit

text.zh: 不比较条件，默认全部自建
text.en: Build everything without comparing conditions

text.zh: 只比较首年价格
text.en: Only compare first-year prices

reason.zh: 路径选择应结合能力、期限和完整约束。
reason.en: Delivery choices must reflect capability, timing and lifecycle constraints.

prompt.zh: 问题是明确的固定审批阈值，现有规则可靠，改成AI没有已验证收益。应如何处理？
prompt.en: A fixed approval rule works reliably and AI has no verified benefit. What should happen?

text.zh: 保留规则方案，把AI方案暂停或终止
text.en: Keep the rule-based alternative and pause or end the AI proposal

text.zh: 只比较模型供应商
text.en: Only compare model suppliers

text.zh: 已经做过演示，所以必须继续
text.en: Continue because a demo was built

reason.zh: 非AI方案和停止条件是战略决策的一部分。
reason.en: Non-AI alternatives and stop conditions belong in strategy.

prompt.zh: 按本演练的切换要求铺路：先确认资料，再验证性能，演练回退，最后受控切换。
prompt.en: Follow this exercise’s migration gate: data, performance, fallback rehearsal, then controlled cutover.

text.zh: 核对数据、接口与权限
text.en: Verify data, interfaces and access

text.zh: 比较新旧性能与完整成本
text.en: Compare performance and full cost

text.zh: 演练故障与回退，明确负责人
text.en: Rehearse fallback and assign owners

text.zh: 按验收结果受控切换
text.en: Cut over under acceptance criteria

reason.zh: 切换成功包括业务连续性，而不只是新系统能打开。
reason.en: Successful migration includes continuity, not merely a running new system.

title.zh: 制定符合业务目标的 AI 战略

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练：维修团队说“上一个AI系统”，但还不清楚延误发生在哪个环节，也没有改善口径。三张工作单最终都要完成。请按能产出下一张工作单所需依据的顺序安排；不要按卡片当前摆放排序。
prompt.en: Exercise: a maintenance team requests an AI system, but the delayed step and improvement measure are unknown. All three work orders must eventually be completed. Arrange them so each produces the evidence needed by the next, not by their current display position.

reason.zh: 未定位问题就无法确定该测什么；没有可比较结果就无法判断技术是否有用。若先试模型，得到的只是工具表现而不是业务改善证据。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Without a diagnosed problem the team cannot choose the right measure; without comparable outcomes it cannot judge technology usefulness. Trying a model first supplies tool performance, not evidence of business improvement. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 用约定的验收口径比较技术方案
text.en: Compare technology options using the agreed acceptance measures

text.zh: 查明受影响人员、维修环节和延误原因
text.en: Investigate affected people, workflow steps and causes of delay

text.zh: 依据查明的问题记录基线并约定改善口径
text.en: Record a baseline and agree improvement measures for the diagnosed problem

prompt.zh: 本演练只比较同一年、相同功能与合规条件下的成本，不据此单独决定购买。购买：许可20、集成10、运维15、退出准备5；自建：开发25、集成10、运维25、退出准备5。分别填写完整成本，单位均为万元。
prompt.en: Exercise: compare costs for the same year, functions and compliance conditions; cost alone does not decide purchasing. Buy: license 20, integration 10, operations 15, exit preparation 5. Build: development 25, integration 10, operations 25, exit preparation 5. Enter full costs in ten-thousand currency units.

reason.zh: 购买完整成本20+10+15+5=50；自建25+10+25+5=65。只看许可或开发会漏持续成本；还须另外核验能力、交期与条款。 回看“自建、购买或合作：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Full purchase cost is 20+10+15+5=50; build cost is 25+10+25+5=65. License or development alone omits continuing costs; capabilities, deadlines and terms still need separate checks. Revisit Build, buy or partner: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练只有4点试验预算，最低试验价值4点。所有数据授权已核实；A因资料尚不能取得，本轮不可执行；B资料与负责人齐备，成本3价值4；C仅为展示界面，成本1价值0；D资料齐备但成本5价值8。选出本轮可实行且满足预算/价值的组合。分值只用于比较，不表示真实收益。
prompt.en: Exercise trial budget is 4 points with minimum trial value 4. Data authorization is checked for all candidates. A has inaccessible source data and cannot run this round. B has sources and an owner, cost 3/value 4. C is a UI demonstration only, cost 1/value 0. D has sources but costs 5/value 8. Select an executable package meeting the budget and value constraints. Points are comparison assumptions, not real returns.

reason.zh: B具备试验条件且在预算内；D价值虽高但超预算，A无资料无法验证。可以加C但它不增加试验价值，不能以展示代替验证。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: B can be tested within budget; D exceeds it and A lacks the data needed for validation. C may be added but provides no trial value; a demonstration cannot replace validation. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: A：资料不可取得，成本1，价值9
text.en: A: inaccessible data, cost 1, value 9

text.zh: B：有资料与负责人，成本3，价值4
text.en: B: sources and owner ready, cost 3, value 4

text.zh: C：只做展示，成本1，价值0
text.en: C: demonstration only, cost 1, value 0

text.zh: D：成本5，价值8
text.en: D: cost 5, value 8

prompt.zh: 本演练：固定税号格式校验由明确规则完全解决；AI方案成本更高且没有额外收益。选择方案。
prompt.en: Exercise: explicit rules fully validate a fixed tax-ID format. AI costs more with no extra benefit. Choose.

reason.zh: 题设中规则已满足目标；新增AI没有证明收益。 回看「什么时候不该用AI」。
reason.en: Rules already meet the stated goal; added AI has no demonstrated benefit. Revisit “When not to use AI”.

text.zh: 必须训练模型
text.en: Train a model regardless

text.zh: 采用规则校验
text.en: Use rules validation

text.zh: 用生成文本代替校验
text.en: Replace validation with generated prose

prompt.zh: 本演练：试切换共400次请求，12次失败，旧流程仍可人工受理。填写本次失败率百分数，不输入%符号。
prompt.en: Exercise: a limited cutover handled 400 requests with 12 failures; manual processing remains available. Enter the failure percentage without the % sign.

reason.zh: 12÷400×100%=3%。失败比例是运行证据，不等于已经确定根因，也不能单靠系统能启动宣告迁移成功。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 12÷400×100%=3%. This is operating evidence, not an established cause or proof of migration success. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练：组织预先约定超过2%应停止扩大试切换；自动恢复路径尚未演练，人工受理已验证可用。选择合理处置。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise: the organization predeclared a pause on expansion above 2%; automatic recovery is untested while manual handling is verified. Select an appropriate response.

reason.zh: 3%超过预设2%门槛；先限制影响、使用已验证连续性安排，并验证缺失条件。这里不要求等待根因确认后才控制影响。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 3% exceeds the predefined 2% gate. Limit impact, use verified continuity arrangements and validate missing conditions. Impact control need not wait for root-cause confirmation. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 跳过演练直接把全部请求切到未知自动恢复路径
text.en: Move all requests to the untested automatic recovery path

text.zh: 只要能启动就继续全量替换
text.en: Continue a full replacement because the system starts

text.zh: 暂停扩大并用已验证人工路径维持服务，补齐恢复验证
text.en: Pause expansion, maintain service with verified manual handling and validate recovery

prompt.zh: 本演练收集了三张项目便笺。把现状证据、预期结果与技术选择分别归档；不能把技术名当成结果。
prompt.en: Three project notes were collected in this exercise. File current-state evidence, desired outcomes and technology choices separately; a technology name is not an outcome.

reason.zh: 现状记录提供比较基线；质量与时间的目标是可测结果；模型采购是候选手段。混淆它们就无法判断改善。 回看“问题、受益者与可观测结果：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Current-state records provide the baseline; quality and time targets define measurable outcomes; model purchasing is a possible means. Confusing them prevents improvement assessment. Revisit Problem, beneficiary and outcome: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

text.zh: 现状证据
text.en: Current-state evidence

text.zh: 预期结果
text.en: Desired outcome

text.zh: 技术候选
text.en: Technology option

text.zh: 客服查一份制度平均需8分钟
text.en: Support needs an average of 8 minutes to locate a policy

text.zh: 缩短查找时间且质量不下降
text.en: Reduce lookup time without lowering quality

text.zh: 评估购买某模型服务
text.en: Evaluate a model-service purchase

prompt.zh: 本演练：三个月上线且无运维团队；现成服务满足需求。选择合理下一步。
prompt.en: Exercise: launch in three months, no operations team, and a managed service fits needs. Choose the next step.

reason.zh: 条件使购买值得优先评估，但适配和责任仍要核验。 回看「自建、购买与合作的比较维度」。
reason.en: The conditions favor evaluating purchase, while fit and responsibilities still need checking. Revisit “Build, buy and partner criteria”.

text.zh: 购买后不再检查数据用途
text.en: Stop checking data use after purchase

text.zh: 评估购买方案的条款、集成和退出成本并保留用途责任
text.en: Evaluate purchase terms, integration and exit costs while retaining use responsibilities

text.zh: 无条件自建且不估维护
text.en: Build unconditionally without estimating maintenance

prompt.zh: 本演练：预算5，最低价值6，必须做授权审查。选项目，禁止项不可选。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 5, minimum value 6, authorization review required; blocked items cannot be selected.

reason.zh: 审查与获授权试点合计成本5价值6；禁止项即使价值高仍不可入选。 回看「价值、可行性与硬性约束」。
reason.en: Review plus authorized pilot cost 5 and yield value 6; blocked work remains ineligible despite its score. Revisit “Value, feasibility and hard constraints”.

text.zh: 授权审查，成本1，价值1
text.en: Authorization review: cost 1, value 1

text.zh: 获授权试点，成本4，价值5
text.en: Authorized pilot: cost 4, value 5

text.zh: 未授权高收益项目，禁止
text.en: Unauthorized high-return project: blocked

prompt.zh: 本演练评审两项申请：A的既有检索已满足找文件目标，新增生成器未改善结果且增加成本；B有预测价值假设，但训练资料无法取得。分别将当前主要停止/暂停理由归类，不依据已花多少钱。
prompt.en: Exercise review: A already meets its document-finding objective through search; adding a generator does not improve outcomes and increases cost. B has a predictive-value hypothesis but cannot obtain training sources. Classify the current primary stopping or pause reason, not past spending.

reason.zh: A是替代方案已达标而增量价值不足；B是验证条件缺失。两者都不能靠沉没投入或AI标签合理化，处理原因却不同。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: A lacks incremental value because an alternative already works; B lacks validation prerequisites. Neither sunk spending nor an AI label resolves either problem, and the reasons differ. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 没有可验证的新增价值
text.en: No verifiable added value

text.zh: 无法验证所需数据条件
text.en: Required data conditions cannot be validated

text.zh: A：现有检索达标，新增成本却无改善
text.en: A: search meets the goal; added cost brings no improvement

text.zh: B：预测假设待验，训练资料不可取得
text.en: B: prediction hypothesis untested; training sources unavailable

prompt.zh: 本演练：夜间试运行800次请求，24次失败。请算出失败率百分数；已批准的回退门槛为2%，门槛不因本轮结果改变。
prompt.en: Exercise: a nighttime pilot has 24 failures among 800 requests. Calculate the failure percentage. The approved rollback gate is 2% and does not change because of this result.

reason.zh: 24÷800×100%=3%；这是观测结果，不能把它写成预先政策门槛。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 24÷800×100%=3%; this is an observation, not a replacement for the predeclared policy threshold. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练。组织预案的一般授权政策是：只有当前当班且响应资格有效的团队可接手异常；执行某恢复路径还需该团队具备这条路径的有效演练记录；没人获准临时放宽门槛。角色登记：甲组响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效，但本时段不当班；乙组当前当班、响应资格有效、旧流程恢复演练有效；丙组当前当班、响应资格有效，但尚无恢复演练记录；丁组当前当班、完成过旧流程演练，但响应资格尚未批准。新平台自动恢复尚无任何团队的有效演练记录。依据政策与角色登记交叉判断本时段允许的组合，不凭会操作或人在场就推定授权。以上为本演练政策。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise. General authorization policy: a team may take over an incident only while on duty and holding a valid response qualification. Executing a recovery route additionally requires that team to have a valid drill record for that route. Nobody may relax the threshold ad hoc. Roster: Team A has valid response qualification and an old-process recovery drill but is off duty; Team B is on duty with both qualification and that drill; Team C is on duty and qualified but has no recovery drill; Team D is on duty and has completed the old-process drill but its response qualification is not yet approved. No team has a valid new-platform recovery drill. Cross-check the roster against policy to select permitted combinations for this period; presence or ability alone does not establish authorization. This policy applies only to the exercise.

reason.zh: 甲组缺当前当班条件，丁组缺正式响应资格，两者都不能仅凭资历或会操作接手。乙组同时满足接手条件和旧流程恢复演练条件；丙组能接手但缺恢复演练，不能执行恢复。新平台无人有有效演练，且任何组都不能放宽门槛。判断来自条件交叉，而不是照抄一个给定角色名称。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Team A lacks current duty coverage; Team D lacks formal response qualification. Neither tenure nor operating skill alone permits takeover. Team B meets takeover and old-process drill conditions. Team C may take over but lacks the drill needed for recovery. Nobody has a valid new-platform drill or authority to relax the threshold. The judgment cross-checks conditions rather than copies a named role. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 甲组
text.en: Team A

text.zh: 乙组
text.en: Team B

text.zh: 丙组
text.en: Team C

text.zh: 丁组
text.en: Team D

text.zh: 接手当前夜间异常
text.en: Take over the current nighttime incident

text.zh: 执行旧流程恢复
text.en: Execute old-process recovery

text.zh: 执行新平台自动恢复
text.en: Execute new-platform automatic recovery

text.zh: 自行放宽回退门槛
text.en: Relax the rollback threshold

title.zh: 金松鼠收益账房

brief.zh: 把凭证分类、算清净收益，并辨别哪些数字真正证明价值。
brief.en: Classify receipts, calculate net value and distinguish evidence from activity.

prompt.zh: 将凭证放入正确账格，不能把同一份省时重复记账。
prompt.en: File each receipt correctly and do not double-count the same time saving.

text.zh: 完整成本
text.en: Full cost

text.zh: 已兑现现金收益
text.en: Realized cash benefit

text.zh: 释放产能
text.en: Released capacity

text.zh: 部署、培训及复核支出
text.en: Deployment, training and review expenditure

text.zh: 支出凭证证明减少了20万元外包费
text.en: Receipts confirm 200,000 less outsourcing spend

text.zh: 每周省十小时，但工资支出未变化
text.en: Ten hours freed with unchanged payroll

reason.zh: 现金节省需要支出变化证据，释放工时需要单独说明实现方式。
reason.en: Cash savings need expenditure evidence; released time needs a separate realization case.

prompt.zh: 同一期间，收益150万元；部署40、运行30、培训10、复核20万元。填写完整成本、净收益与简单ROI（百分数，不带%）。
prompt.en: Same period: benefits 150; deployment 40, operations 30, training 10, review 20. Enter total cost, net benefit and simple ROI as a percentage.

reason.en: Total cost is 100 and net benefit 50; ROI is 50%.

prompt.zh: 把记录放到基线、早期信号或业务结果中。
prompt.en: Place records under baseline, early signal or business outcome.

text.zh: 实施前基线
text.en: Pre-pilot baseline

text.zh: 先导信号
text.en: Leading signal

text.zh: 实际业务结果
text.en: Business outcome

text.zh: 上线前同类工单总处理时间
text.en: Comparable handling time before launch

text.zh: 员工培训完成率
text.en: Training completion rate

text.zh: 上线后同口径差错率与净收益
text.en: Comparable post-launch error rate and net benefit

reason.zh: 先导信号帮助跟踪，但必须用后续结果验证。
reason.en: Leading signals support tracking but need validation against later outcomes.

title.zh: 衡量和演示 AI 商业价值

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练将指标分入“可核验金额”或“单独测量的体验”；不作金额折算。
prompt.en: Exercise: classify measures as verifiable money or separately measured experience; do not convert experience into cash.

reason.zh: 已兑现金额与体验改善都可有价值，但后者没有题设支持的现金换算。 回看「有形与无形收益」。
reason.en: Realized money and experience can both matter, but no cash conversion for experience is supported here. Revisit “Tangible and intangible benefits”.

text.zh: 可核验金额
text.en: Verifiable money

text.zh: 体验指标
text.en: Experience measure

text.zh: 已兑现支出减少2万元
text.en: Realized spending reduction of 20,000

text.zh: 满意度问卷提高
text.en: Improved satisfaction survey

text.zh: 已收到新增收入
text.en: Additional revenue actually received

prompt.zh: 本演练配送异常工单旧流程每单65分钟；新流程生成初稿7分钟、核验修改18分钟，其他环节耗时不变。填写包含核验后的每单净节省分钟数，不把生成初稿当整单处理完成。
prompt.en: Exercise: the old delivery-exception workflow took 65 minutes per case. The new workflow uses 7 minutes to draft and 18 minutes to verify and correct; other steps are unchanged. Enter net minutes saved per case including review, rather than treat drafting as the whole process.

reason.zh: 新流程需7+18=25分钟，65−25=40分钟。只用生成时间会把仍需核验的工作当作已经省去；本结果是时间变化，不直接等于现金减少。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: The new workflow takes 7+18=25 minutes, so 65−25=40 minutes are saved. Using drafting time alone ignores verification work. Time change does not directly establish reduced cash expenditure. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 本演练：同年收益180万元，部署40、调用20、培训10、维护20、复核10万元。填简单ROI百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: same-year benefits 180; costs: deployment 40, usage 20, training 10, maintenance 20, review 10, all in the same unit. Enter simple ROI percent.

reason.zh: 完整成本100，净收益80，因此ROI=80/100=80%；不能漏复核或把收益当净收益。 回看「收益与ROI」。
reason.en: Full costs are 100 and net benefit 80, so ROI is 80%; include review and subtract costs. Revisit “Benefits and ROI”.

label.en: ROI percent (enter a number without the % sign)

prompt.zh: 本演练：将培训完成率与已实现净收益分到相应类别。
prompt.en: Exercise: classify training completion and realized net benefit.

reason.zh: 培训可能支持成功条件，但最终净收益需要另行观察。 回看「先导性指标」。
reason.en: Training may support success conditions, but final net benefit requires separate observation. Revisit “Leading indicators”.

text.zh: 先导信号
text.en: Leading signal

text.zh: 结果
text.en: Outcome

text.zh: 培训完成率
text.en: Training completion

text.zh: 已实现净收益
text.en: Realized net benefit

prompt.zh: 本演练当月已有质量验收通过，不得用降质省钱。固定运维40万元，调用20000次、每次10元，复核1000次、每次100元；月预算80万元。填写总成本和预算余量，单位万元。
prompt.en: Exercise quality acceptance has passed and may not be sacrificed for savings. Monthly fixed operations cost 40 ten-thousand units; 20,000 calls cost 10 currency units each; 1,000 reviews cost 100 each. Budget: 80 ten-thousand units. Enter total cost and remaining budget in ten-thousand units.

reason.zh: 调用20万元、复核10万元，加固定40共70，余量80−70=10。漏复核或混用元与万元会低估成本；优化仍要保持质量。 回看“成本规划与优化：决策演练”和本演练条件。
reason.en: Calls cost 20 ten-thousand units and review 10; plus fixed 40 gives 70, leaving 80−70=10. Omitting review or mixing units understates cost; optimization must preserve quality. Revisit Cost planning and optimization: decision lab and the stated exercise conditions.

prompt.zh: 本演练：分类指标，活动是做了多少，结果是业务表现变化。
prompt.en: Exercise: classify measures; activity counts actions, outcomes capture business change.

reason.zh: 账号数记录部署活动；差错和含复核周期才反映该业务表现。 回看「结果指标与活动指标」。
reason.en: Account count records deployment; errors and review-inclusive cycle time reflect workflow performance. Revisit “Outcome and activity measures”.

text.zh: 活动
text.en: Activity

text.zh: 结果
text.en: Outcome

text.zh: 开通账号数
text.en: Accounts created

text.zh: 工单差错率
text.en: Ticket error rate

text.zh: 含复核的处理周期
text.en: Handling cycle including review

prompt.zh: 本演练：实际支出减少5万元，信任问卷提高但无货币换算依据。选择报告。
prompt.en: Exercise: spending falls by 50,000; trust surveys improve without a monetary conversion basis. Choose a report.

reason.zh: 金额已核验，信任有独立测量；不能凭空赋予现金额。 回看「有形收益与无形收益」。
reason.en: Money is verified and trust measured separately; no invented cash value is justified. Revisit “Tangible and intangible benefits”.

text.zh: 信任无需测量
text.en: Trust needs no measurement

text.zh: 分别报告5万元支出减少与信任问卷变化
text.en: Report the 50,000 reduction separately from trust survey changes

text.zh: 将信任提升记作另5万元现金
text.en: Record trust improvement as another 50,000 cash

prompt.zh: 本演练：同期工单难度下降且上线AI。选择更能区分AI效果的下一轮设计。
prompt.en: Exercise: tickets became easier while AI launched. Select the next design that better distinguishes AI effects.

reason.zh: 匹配与对照减少同期变化干扰；不同任务直接比较不能支持该归因。 回看「可比较基线与归因」。
reason.en: Matching and comparison reduce confounding; unlike tasks do not support attribution. Revisit “Comparable baselines and attribution”.

text.zh: 按难度和业务量匹配，统一含复核口径设置对照
text.en: Match difficulty and volume, use review-inclusive definitions and a comparison group

text.zh: 把所有改善都记给AI
text.en: Attribute every improvement to AI

text.zh: 只比较去年最难工单和本月最易工单
text.en: Compare last year’s hardest with this month’s easiest tickets

prompt.zh: 本演练收到三份ROI申请。将可按当前材料计算同期间简单ROI的申请，与必须补资料的申请分开。不需要算出ROI。
prompt.en: Exercise: three ROI requests arrive. Separate those whose current evidence permits a same-period simple ROI calculation from those needing more information. Do not calculate ROI.

reason.zh: 简单ROI要求收益与完整成本在同期间、同单位和明确实现范围内。两个缺口申请不是收益一定差，而是当前材料不足以计算可比较的结果。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Simple ROI needs benefits and full costs within the same period, units and realization scope. The incomplete requests do not necessarily have poor returns; their evidence is insufficient for comparable calculation. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 当前核算范围足够
text.en: Current accounting scope sufficient

text.zh: 需要补齐核算资料
text.en: Accounting information missing

text.zh: 同一年已兑现收益和该年全部数据/部署/运行/培训/复核/维护/退出成本，单位一致
text.en: Realized benefits and all data, deployment, operating, training, review, maintenance and exit costs for the same year, in common units

text.zh: 仅有本季度收益和全年成本，未说明对应关系
text.en: Only quarterly benefits and annual costs, with no period reconciliation

text.zh: 报告明确尚未纳入人工复核成本
text.en: The report explicitly excludes human-review costs

prompt.zh: 本演练只核对一项同期间、同服务质量的外包支出：旧账单12000元，新账单8500元，均已结算。甲部门把这笔减少报告为收益，乙部门也引用同一张新旧账单，汇总表把两份报告都相加。填写这项实际现金支出减少，以及汇总表因重复报告而多记的金额；不计算整个项目净收益。
prompt.en: Exercise: check one outsourced expense for the same period and service quality. The old invoice was 12,000 and the new invoice 8,500; both are settled. Department A reports this reduction as a benefit, and Department B cites the very same invoice pair. A summary adds both reports. Enter the actual cash expenditure reduction and the summary overstatement from duplication. Do not calculate the whole project net benefit.

reason.zh: 这项支出只实际减少12000−8500=3500元。两份报告指向同一账单变化，合计7000会多记3500；报告数量不增加已兑现现金。这里只验证该项支出，不能据此跳过整个项目其他成本。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: This expense fell by 12,000−8,500=3,500. Two reports concern the same invoice change; recording 7,000 overstates it by 3,500. More reports do not create more realized cash. This checks one expense, not the rest of the project costs. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

label.zh: 这项实际现金支出减少（元）
label.en: Actual cash reduction for this expense

prompt.zh: 本演练：培训完成率由50%升至95%。同口径服务记录为培训前200笔20笔差错，培训后300笔30笔差错。填写前后差错率百分数。
prompt.en: Exercise: training completion increased from 50% to 95%. Comparable service records show 20 errors in 200 cases before training and 30 in 300 after. Enter the two error percentages.

reason.zh: 20÷200与30÷300都等于10%；不同业务量必须先统一比例，不能只比差错个数。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 20÷200 and 30÷300 both equal 10%; normalize different volumes before comparing rather than use counts alone. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 根据刚才本演练的两期差错率，哪些报告表述有依据？
prompt.en: Using the two exercise error rates, which report statements are supported?

reason.zh: 早期信号提高而差错率不变，说明不能用活动代替业务结果。未观察到本指标改善也不证明培训完全无价值，仍需调查能力和其他结果。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: The signal improved while error rate stayed the same, so activity cannot replace outcomes. Lack of improvement in this metric does not prove training has no value; investigate capability and other outcomes. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 培训完成率已足以证明业务质量提高
text.en: Training completion alone proves better service quality

text.zh: 当前服务质量指标尚未显示改善，需调查联系
text.en: The current service-quality metric shows no improvement; investigate the link

text.zh: 培训完成这一早期信号提高
text.en: The early training-completion signal improved

prompt.zh: 本演练年度预算：数据整理10、集成20、调用30、培训5、复核15、监测维护10、退出准备10（万元）。求总成本。
prompt.en: Exercise annual budget: data 10, integration 20, calls 30, training 5, review 15, monitoring/maintenance 10, exit preparation 10. Sum costs in the same unit.

reason.zh: 各项合计100；只报调用30会漏掉数据、人工与生命周期支出。 回看「全生命周期成本」。
reason.en: The sum is 100; reporting calls alone omits data, human and lifecycle expenses. Revisit “Lifecycle cost”.

title.zh: 奇想商业画布

brief.zh: 搭建客户价值、交付能力与持续优势，而不只堆叠AI标签。
brief.en: Build customer value, delivery capability and durable advantage.

prompt.zh: 小镇维修服务要提供可核验的持续监测。预算6点，至少6点价值；必须具备客户问题和获授权的反馈。选择画布组件。
prompt.en: A maintenance service needs verifiable ongoing monitoring. Budget 6, value target 6. Customer need and authorized feedback are mandatory.

text.zh: 验证客户停机损失：成本1，价值1
text.en: Validate downtime needs: cost 1, value 1

text.zh: 获授权维修反馈与维护责任：成本2，价值2
text.en: Authorized feedback with ownership: cost 2, value 2

text.zh: 嵌入服务流程与持续改进：成本3，价值3
text.en: Integrated workflow and improvement: cost 3, value 3

text.zh: 只增加AI品牌标签：成本4，价值1
text.en: AI branding only: cost 4, value 1

reason.zh: 客户需求、获授权反馈和实际工作流形成互补；相同模型或标签不足以证明持续优势。
reason.en: Customer needs, authorized feedback and workflows complement one another; a model label alone is insufficient.

prompt.zh: 从一次性维修报告转为持续监测订阅，哪些部分必须重新评估？
prompt.en: Moving from one-off reports to a monitoring subscription requires reassessing which elements?

text.zh: 客户持续获得的价值
text.en: Ongoing customer value

text.zh: 持续交付与支持责任
text.en: Ongoing delivery and support

text.zh: 订阅收益与完整成本
text.en: Subscription revenue and full costs

text.zh: 只更换产品名称即可
text.en: Only rename the product

reason.zh: 业务模式连接价值主张、交付方式和收益逻辑。
reason.en: A business model connects value, delivery and revenue.

prompt.zh: 行业案例很多，但本企业反馈资料不足、尚无维护责任人。应如何安排下一轮投入？
prompt.en: Industry examples are common, but internal feedback data and ownership are missing. How should the next investment proceed?

text.zh: 先补资料责任与验证，再决定扩大投资
text.en: Establish data ownership and validation before expanding

text.zh: 按同行公开预算等额投入
text.en: Match a competitor’s disclosed budget

text.zh: 试点已花钱，所以直接全量扩展
text.en: Scale because pilot costs are sunk

reason.zh: 投资规模要结合自身准备度和可核验结果。
reason.en: Investment should reflect internal readiness and verified results.

title.zh: 确立 AI 所能带来的竞争优势

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行上线聊天机器人，本企业投诉集中在退款等待。选择先调查的内容。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor launches a chatbot; your complaints concern refund delays. Choose the first investigation.

reason.zh: 投资需要连接客户问题与自身条件；复制工具无法证明能解决退款障碍。 回看「竞争格局」。
reason.en: Investment needs a link to customer problems and local conditions; imitation does not establish a refund solution. Revisit “Competitive landscape”.

text.zh: 直接复制同行采购清单
text.en: Copy the competitor purchasing list

text.zh: 同行界面的配色
text.en: Competitor interface colors

text.zh: 退款流程障碍、客户期待与自身可改善环节
text.en: Refund workflow barriers, customer expectations and improvable steps

prompt.zh: 本演练：一次性报告转为持续决策服务。选择必须重新评估的全部事项。
prompt.en: Exercise: one-off reports become continuous decision support. Select all items requiring reassessment.

reason.zh: 持续服务改变交付与维护要求；标签不能替代客户价值和运营方案。 回看「业务模式转型」。
reason.en: Continuous service changes delivery and maintenance; labels cannot replace value and operations. Revisit “Business model transformation”.

text.zh: 持续客户价值与服务交付流程
text.en: Ongoing customer value and service delivery

text.zh: 只修改产品标签
text.en: Change only the product label

text.zh: 数据维护和运营责任
text.en: Data maintenance and operational ownership

prompt.zh: 本演练两团队使用同一模型。甲有已授权的维修反馈、领域人员复核、流程责任人与定期结果回看；乙只有更多账号和一次发布会。选择材料目前支持的判断。
prompt.en: Exercise: two teams use the same model. Team A has authorized maintenance feedback, domain review, workflow owners and regular outcome review. Team B has more accounts and a launch event. Select judgments supported by the evidence.

reason.zh: 差别在资料使用、领域能力、流程与反馈，不在模型名称。甲有更充分的能力条件证据，但这些条件也不是永久收益保证。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: The difference concerns sources, domain skills, workflows and feedback rather than a model name. A has stronger capability evidence, but those conditions do not guarantee permanent returns. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 甲已经保证永久领先，不必再观察
text.en: A is guaranteed permanent leadership and needs no more monitoring

text.zh: 模型相同，所以两队业务能力与价值一定相同
text.en: The same model guarantees equal business capabilities and value

text.zh: 甲展示了可持续积累所需的互补条件，但仍须跟踪结果
text.en: A shows complementary conditions for sustained learning, though outcomes still need tracking

text.zh: 乙的账号数量不能单独证明持续优势
text.en: B account counts alone do not establish durable advantage

prompt.zh: 本演练当前可支配预算6点；扩展前必须补资料质量和验证小范围结果，二者分别成本2、价值2。培训支持成本2、价值1；直接全量扩展成本6、价值9，但当前准备不足，尚未获准执行。选择满足最低验证价值4且包含必要验证工作的组合；分值仅为演练设定。
prompt.en: Exercise: current budget is 6 points. Before expansion, data-quality work and limited outcome validation are mandatory, each cost 2/value 2. Training support costs 2/value 1. Full rollout costs 6/value 9 but is not authorized because readiness is incomplete. Select a package providing minimum validation value 4 and the necessary work. Scores are exercise assumptions.

reason.zh: 先投入资料与结果验证至少花4点并达到验证目标；培训可在预算内补充，未获准全量扩展不能因高分入选。外部压力不补内部条件。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Source and outcome validation cost at least 4 points and meet the validation objective. Training can be added within budget; unauthorized full rollout cannot be selected for its high score. External pressure does not repair internal conditions. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 补齐资料质量：成本2，价值2
text.en: Repair source quality: cost 2, value 2

text.zh: 验证小范围结果：成本2，价值2
text.en: Validate limited outcomes: cost 2, value 2

text.zh: 培训与支持：成本2，价值1
text.en: Training and support: cost 2, value 1

text.zh: 未获准全量扩展：成本6，价值9
text.en: Unauthorized full rollout: cost 6, value 9

prompt.zh: 本演练：同行投入千万，本企业尚未定位客户障碍。选择有证据意识的动作。
prompt.en: Exercise: a competitor spends ten million; your customer barriers are unknown. Choose an evidence-oriented action.

reason.zh: 竞争变化是调查线索，不是本企业的收益证明；需要自身业务证据。 回看「客户问题与竞争位置」。
reason.en: Competitive change prompts investigation; it does not prove your returns. Local evidence is needed. Revisit “Customer need and competitive position”.

text.zh: 调查客户期待、交付障碍与价值链影响
text.en: Investigate customer expectations, delivery barriers and value-chain effects

text.zh: 假定相同工具产生相同价值
text.en: Assume the same tool gives equal value

text.zh: 无条件投入更大金额
text.en: Spend more unconditionally

prompt.zh: 本演练持续监测服务：将方案条目归入价值、交付、收益。
prompt.en: Exercise continuous monitoring service: classify each proposal component as value, delivery or revenue.

reason.zh: 提醒说明客户所得，维护响应说明如何交付，收费说明价值获取；三者不能用标签代替。 回看「价值主张、交付与收益逻辑」。
reason.en: Alerts define value, maintenance defines delivery and charging defines capture; a label replaces none of them. Revisit “Value proposition, delivery and revenue”.

text.zh: 客户价值
text.en: Customer value

text.zh: 交付方式
text.en: Delivery

text.zh: 收益逻辑
text.en: Revenue

text.zh: 及时获得异常提醒
text.en: Timely exception alerts

text.zh: 团队持续维护与响应
text.en: Team maintains service and responds continuously

text.zh: 按约定服务期收费
text.en: Charge for an agreed service period

prompt.zh: 本演练：服务团队收到获准用于改进的客户投诉，投诉中有重复且未经核验的记录。领域人员要据此测试新的预约流程，并判断它是否真的减少失约。安排以下工作；客户同意的用途不能扩大为公开发布。
prompt.en: Exercise: a service team receives complaints authorized for improvement, including duplicates and unverified records. Domain staff will test a new booking workflow and determine whether it reduces missed appointments. Arrange the work below; the consented use does not permit public release.

reason.zh: 未经核验的重复投诉不能可靠说明问题；有实际问题才可设计相应改动，运行后才有新流程结果可比较。模型采购本身不会产生这条证据闭环。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: Unverified duplicate complaints do not reliably establish the problem. A diagnosed problem guides a relevant change, whose later operation supplies comparable outcomes. Model procurement alone produces none of this evidence loop. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 按相同口径比较新流程失约结果，并把问题返回下一轮
text.en: Compare missed appointments consistently after the change and feed issues into the next round

text.zh: 去重核验获授权投诉，明确实际问题
text.en: Deduplicate and verify authorized complaints to identify the actual problem

text.zh: 领域人员依据已核验问题设计并试行预约改动
text.en: Domain staff design and try a booking change using the verified problem

prompt.zh: 本演练扩展门槛要求月成本不超过10万元。新部门测得每月固定费4万元、调用费5万元、复核费3万元。填写当前完整月成本和超过门槛的金额，单位万元。
prompt.en: Exercise expansion gate: monthly cost must not exceed 10 ten-thousand currency units. The new department has fixed cost 4, calls 5 and review 3 in that unit. Enter full monthly cost and the amount above the gate.

reason.zh: 4+5+3=12，超额12−10=2。复核费是成本，不能为了过门槛从报告删除。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: 4+5+3=12; the excess is 12−10=2. Review is a cost and cannot be removed from reporting to pass the gate. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

prompt.zh: 接续本演练：质量与风险审查均已达标，但上述成本尚未降到批准门槛内。选择当前有依据的承诺。
prompt.en: Continuing the exercise: quality and risk review pass, but cost has not met the approved gate. Select the evidence-based commitment.

reason.zh: 多维硬门槛必须同时满足，不能用一项成功掩盖另一项失败；应验证成本改进而非事后改报告。 回看对应知识与题面证据。
reason.en: All hard gates must be met together; one success cannot conceal another failure. Validate a cost improvement rather than rewrite the report. Revisit the linked knowledge and case evidence.

text.zh: 暂停扩大，验证成本改进后重新评估，保留既定质量要求
text.en: Pause expansion and re-evaluate after verified cost improvements while retaining quality requirements

text.zh: 质量通过即可抵消成本超额，立刻扩大
text.en: Passing quality offsets excess cost, so expand now

text.zh: 先删复核费或放宽门槛再宣布达标
text.en: Delete review costs or relax the gate before declaring success

title.zh: 星光守护天平

brief.zh: 面对目标冲突，选择能真正执行的保障措施，并保留知情与复核。
brief.en: Balance conflicting goals with implemented safeguards, disclosure and review.

prompt.zh: 虚构服务审批试点：平均表现良好，但某地区错误率高，使用者不知道AI参与。选择需要补齐的措施。
prompt.en: A fictional service-approval pilot has high errors in one region and undisclosed AI use. Select the needed safeguards.

text.zh: 调查相关群体差异与影响
text.en: Investigate subgroup errors and impacts

text.zh: 说明AI参与、限制及申诉渠道
text.en: Disclose AI involvement, limits and recourse

text.zh: 提供适合使用者理解的依据
text.en: Provide understandable grounds

text.zh: 只展示平均准确率
text.en: Only show average accuracy

reason.zh: 公平性、透明度和可说明性需要具体实现，不能用平均指标替代。
reason.en: Implement fairness, transparency and explainability rather than substituting an average score.

prompt.zh: 团队想提高自动处理率，但有重要未知结论。复核人员没有原文和停止权限。请选择合理的改动。
prompt.en: The team wants more automation, but important claims are unknown and reviewers lack sources and stop authority. Choose suitable changes.

text.zh: 给复核者证据、时间和停止权限
text.en: Give reviewers evidence, time and stop authority

text.zh: 设定无来源重要结论的升级条件与接手人
text.en: Define escalation triggers and owners

text.zh: 记录收益、影响与取舍责任
text.en: Record benefits, impacts and decision ownership

text.zh: 只保留人工确认按钮
text.en: Keep only a human confirmation button

reason.zh: 有能力的复核与明确升级才能改变风险，按钮本身不能。
reason.en: Capable review and defined escalation change risk; a button alone does not.

prompt.zh: 还在设计检索服务。哪些工作应当现在纳入？
prompt.en: A retrieval service is still in design. What belongs in the design work?

text.zh: 落实数据权限与允许用途
text.en: Implement data permissions and permitted uses

text.zh: 测试异常输入与失败时的接手
text.en: Test abnormal inputs and failure handling

text.zh: 限制敏感资料使用并保留维护责任
text.en: Limit sensitive-data use and assign owners

text.zh: 等上线后只加免责声明
text.en: Add only a disclaimer after launch

reason.zh: 隐私、安全和稳健性应进入设计与验证。
reason.en: Privacy, security and robustness belong in design and validation.

title.zh: 在制订业务决策时应用负责任的 AI 原则

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 团队只有一张责任原则海报。选择所有能产生实际评估或控制证据的补充工作。
prompt.en: The team has only a principles poster. Select every addition that produces actual assessment or control evidence.

reason.zh: 分组差错评估和异常条件测试让原则进入实际验证；仅改宣传措辞不能证明控制有效。 常见错误：有原则海报就等于已治理。 回看《负责任的AI原则》。
reason.en: Subgroup error assessment and abnormal-condition tests operationalize principles; promotional wording does not demonstrate effective controls. Common error: A principles poster is treated as implemented governance. Review “Responsible AI principles”.

text.zh: 记录相关群体的差错并评审
text.en: Record and review errors for relevant groups

text.zh: 在异常输入下测试并记录结果
text.en: Test abnormal inputs and record results

text.zh: 把海报换成更醒目的颜色
text.en: Change the poster to brighter colors

prompt.zh: 演练给定：预算3；必须做影响记录和责任确认；总控制值至少3。选择满足全部约束的工作包。分值只用于本题。
prompt.en: Exercise: budget 3; impact recording and owner confirmation are mandatory; total control value must reach 3. Select a feasible package. Scores apply only here.

reason.zh: 影响记录和责任确认各占1预算，风险控制占1，恰好达到3；纯加速项不满足责任硬约束。取舍需记录理由。 常见错误：以最高效率替代对影响和责任的说明。 回看《目标冲突与取舍》。
reason.en: Impact recording, owner confirmation and risk control each cost 1 and jointly reach 3. Acceleration alone misses mandatory responsibility constraints. Record the trade-off rationale. Common error: Maximum efficiency replaces explanation of impact and ownership. Review “Competing objectives and trade-offs”.

text.zh: 记录影响：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Record impact: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 确认决策责任：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Confirm decision owner: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 风险相称控制：成本1，控制值1
text.en: Proportionate control: cost 1, control value 1

text.zh: 仅提速：成本3，控制值0
text.en: Acceleration only: cost 3, control value 0

prompt.zh: 客服系统尚不清楚谁能使用哪些资料，也没有异常验收。三张工作单分别如下，请组成能支持上线决定的工作路径；题面不指定顺序。
prompt.en: A support system has no defined users/data scope or abnormal-condition acceptance. Build a work path that can support release from these work orders; the sequence is not supplied.

text.zh: 用验证证据决定是否部署
text.en: Decide deployment using validation evidence

text.zh: 围绕这些用途设计监督并验证异常处理
text.en: Design oversight for those uses and validate abnormal handling

text.zh: 界定允许用途、资料与决定责任
text.en: Define allowed uses, sources and decision ownership

reason.zh: 不知道用途和责任就不能合理设计监督；发布决定须用验证结果，不是先上线再补治理。回看“从设计时纳入治理”。
reason.en: Unknown use and ownership prevent sound oversight design; release requires validation evidence rather than later governance. Revisit Governance by Design.

prompt.zh: 本演练中，获授权的审批员已检查独立修复测试，书面批准仅在原有用途的小批量运行；值班监控和停止通道也已就绪。有人提出两种追加意见：“仍须保证永不出错才可运行”，或“既然批准就可扩大到尚未审查的新用途”。选择与现有证据和批准范围相符的行动。
prompt.en: In this exercise, an authorized approver reviewed independent repair tests and documented approval for a small batch within the existing use. Monitoring and a stop channel are ready. Two proposals are added: require a guarantee of no future error, or expand to an unreviewed use because approval exists. Select actions consistent with the evidence and approval scope.

text.zh: 已有批准可解释为对所有用途永久授权
text.en: Interpret approval as permanent authority for every use

text.zh: 在批准的用途与小批范围内运行，保留监控和停止能力
text.en: Operate within the approved use and batch, retaining monitoring and stop capability

text.zh: 若要新增用途，另核对影响和授权范围
text.en: Reassess impacts and authority before adding a new use

text.zh: 只有承诺永不出错才算人工监督有效
text.en: Effective human oversight requires a promise of no errors ever

reason.zh: 这里的授权和独立验证确已存在，不能继续按“模型自信代审批”的旧事实判断。有效监督是在有依据的范围内行动并保留停止/升级，不是保证零错或无限扩权。回看“人工监督与升级”。
reason.en: Approval and independent validation actually exist in this case. Oversight supports action within an evidenced scope with stop/escalation options, not zero-error guarantees or unlimited authority. Revisit Human Oversight and Escalation.

prompt.zh: 演练：总体错误率5%，但未按受影响群体统计。选择所有必要的下一步；本题不设普遍公平阈值。
prompt.en: Exercise: overall error rate is 5%, with no breakdown for affected groups. Select all necessary next steps; no universal fairness threshold is given.

reason.zh: 需要识别相关群体、比较差错和影响，并讨论取舍；一个总体均值不能给出群体分布。 常见错误：总体平均优秀足以证明公平。 回看《公平性与分组表现》。
reason.en: Identify relevant groups, compare errors and impacts, and discuss trade-offs; an aggregate average cannot reveal group distributions. Common error: A strong overall average proves fairness. Review “Fairness and subgroup outcomes”.

text.zh: 直接宣布不存在公平性问题
text.en: Declare no fairness issue immediately

text.zh: 结合用途识别相关群体
text.en: Identify relevant groups for the use

text.zh: 比较群体差错、机会和影响
text.en: Compare group errors, opportunities and impacts

prompt.zh: 借贷建议工具留下两份界面记录。把每份记录送到它最直接改善的目标；本题不判断该建议是否合法或准确。
prompt.en: A lending-advice tool has two interface records. Route each to the goal it most directly improves; this does not determine legality or accuracy.

text.zh: 帮助理解本次判断依据
text.en: Understand this judgment basis

text.zh: 帮助知情使用系统
text.en: Make an informed choice about system use

text.zh: 页面列出本次建议所用资料，并说明哪些因素改变了建议
text.en: The page identifies sources used for this recommendation and factors that changed it

text.zh: 使用前提示会有AI参与，说明它不能处理的用途
text.en: Before use, the page discloses AI participation and excluded uses

reason.zh: 第一份解释具体行为依据，第二份披露参与和限制；只出现AI标识仍不能解释一次判断。回看“可说明性与透明度”。
reason.en: The first explains a decision basis; the second discloses participation and limits. An AI badge alone does not explain a judgment. Revisit Explainability and Transparency.

prompt.zh: 将三个独立检查路由到最直接的目的；这里按题面关注点分类。
prompt.en: Route three checks by their most direct purpose, using the stated focus.

reason.zh: 资料用途关注隐私，阻止未授权访问关注安全，变化条件下表现关注稳健性。控制可能互补，但目的有区别。 常见错误：有访问密码就解决所有隐私和稳健性问题。 回看《隐私、安全与稳健性》。
reason.en: Appropriate data use concerns privacy, unauthorized access concerns security, and behavior under change concerns robustness. Controls can complement one another but have distinct purposes. Common error: A password resolves privacy and robustness too. Review “Privacy, security and robustness”.

text.zh: 隐私
text.en: Privacy

text.zh: 安全
text.en: Security

text.zh: 稳健性
text.en: Robustness

text.zh: 检查个人资料是否用于适当目的
text.en: Check appropriate personal-data purposes

text.zh: 阻止无权限账号进入资料库
text.en: Block unauthorized accounts from the repository

text.zh: 测试输入异常时能否适当运行
text.en: Test appropriate behavior on unusual inputs

prompt.zh: 评审已记录节省时间。选择还应补充的全部信息，以讨论相称控制。
prompt.en: The review records time savings. Select every missing input needed to discuss proportionate controls.

reason.zh: 影响对象、可能性、严重程度、可逆性和决定责任共同支持取舍；厂商品牌不提供这些影响证据。 常见错误：只记录收益，不记录损害严重性和可逆性。 回看《收益、影响与比例原则》。 不可接受风险应依据适用法律、权利保障及场景标准判断，不能仅以业务收益抵扣。
reason.en: Affected people, likelihood, severity, reversibility and decision ownership support the trade-off; a vendor brand provides none of this impact evidence. Common error: Benefits are recorded while severity and reversibility are omitted. Review “Benefits, impacts and proportionate controls”. Assess unacceptable risk against applicable law, rights protections and contextual standards; business benefits alone do not offset it.

text.zh: 只补模型品牌
text.en: Add only the model brand

text.zh: 严重程度与可逆性
text.en: Severity and reversibility

text.zh: 受影响对象及损害可能性
text.en: Affected people and likelihood of harm

text.zh: 控制取舍和决定责任
text.en: Control trade-offs and decision ownership

prompt.zh: 原来只起草内部说明的工具，现在准备自动向客户发送影响其服务资格的结论。当前只测了速度。选择所有必须补入设计与验收的工作。
prompt.en: A tool formerly drafted internal notes and will now automatically send conclusions affecting service eligibility. Only speed has been tested. Select all work missing from design and acceptance.

text.zh: 速度达标即可沿用原用途批准
text.en: Keep the original use approval because speed passed

text.zh: 确定人工介入和失败处置，并验证这些条件
text.en: Define human intervention and failure handling and validate them

text.zh: 界定允许与不允许用途，核对使用资料
text.en: Define permitted and prohibited uses and inspect data use

reason.zh: 用途变化需要在设计与验收中落实保障；速度不能说明新影响已受控制。回看“从用途定义开始设置保障”。
reason.en: Changed use needs safeguards in design and acceptance; speed does not show the new impact is controlled. Revisit Safeguards from Use-Case Definition.

prompt.zh: 演练：复核员只能看到结论，必须立即签字且无暂停权。选择所有必要补强。
prompt.en: Case: a reviewer sees only conclusions, must sign immediately, and cannot pause actions. Select all necessary improvements.

reason.zh: 监督需要证据、时间、训练、停止或修改权，并给无来源结论等触发事件指定接手人；单纯签字不提供能力。 常见错误：安排一个签字人即可构成有效监督。 回看《复核能力与升级阈值》。
reason.en: Oversight needs evidence, time, training, stop or modification authority, and owners for triggers such as unsupported conclusions. A signature alone provides no capability. Common error: Assigning a signer creates effective oversight. Review “Review capability and escalation triggers”.

text.zh: 只增加签字次数
text.en: Only require more signatures

text.zh: 授予停止或修改权限
text.en: Grant stop or modification authority

text.zh: 提供证据、复核时间和训练
text.en: Provide evidence, review time and training

text.zh: 定义无来源结论等升级条件与接手者
text.en: Define unsupported-claim escalation and takeover owners

title.zh: 猫头鹰钥匙柜

brief.zh: 按明确职责发放钥匙，识别用途变化，并把审查资源交给合适的队列。
brief.en: Issue keys by explicit roles, recognize use changes and prioritize review.

prompt.zh: 本演练：客服只读公开政策；业务负责人只批准高额退款；运维只读运行日志。这里没有人事资料授权。仅勾选必要权限。
prompt.en: Exercise roles: support reads public policies; the business owner approves large refunds; operations reads logs. No HR-data access is authorized. Select only necessary permissions.

text.zh: 客服
text.en: Support

text.zh: 业务负责人
text.en: Business owner

text.zh: 运维
text.en: Operations

text.zh: 政策
text.en: Policies

text.zh: 高额退款
text.en: Large refunds

text.zh: 日志
text.en: Logs

text.zh: 人事资料
text.en: HR records

reason.zh: 权限由工作职责决定，并在资料和工具层执行。
reason.en: Enforce role-based least privilege in data and tool layers.

prompt.zh: 内部起草工具准备改成自动决定客户服务资格。下一步是什么？
prompt.en: An internal drafting aid is becoming an automated service-eligibility decision system. What next?

text.zh: 重新核对用途、影响人群、资料与适用要求
text.en: Reassess use, affected people, data and applicable requirements

text.zh: 沿用原审批，不分析新用途
text.en: Reuse the original approval without assessing the new use

text.zh: 把所有使用责任交给供应商
text.en: Transfer all use responsibility to the supplier

reason.zh: 用途变化会改变风险与责任，需要有责任的专业判断。
reason.en: Changed uses require renewed risk and responsibility assessment.

prompt.zh: 本演练将影响个人权益的自动决定送强化审查；内部低影响草稿送普通审查；用途改变送重新评估。
prompt.en: Exercise queues: consequential automated decisions get enhanced review, low-impact drafts standard review, and changed uses reassessment.

text.zh: 强化审查
text.en: Enhanced review

text.zh: 普通审查
text.en: Standard review

text.zh: 重新评估
text.en: Reassessment

text.zh: 自动影响客户权益的决定
text.en: Consequential customer decision

text.zh: 员工核对后的内部会议草稿
text.en: Human-checked internal meeting draft

text.zh: 原来起草，现在自动执行
text.en: A drafting tool now acts automatically

reason.zh: 这里的队列是演练规则，不是法律风险等级；按实际影响和变化安排治理。
reason.en: These are exercise queues, not legal risk classes; prioritize by impacts and changes.

title.zh: 建立 AI 监管结构并确保监管合规

brief.zh: 先发现和整理知识，再看推理示范与引导练习。以下为新情境应用，知识随时可查；示范、收藏与基础确认不计理解通过。整章完成后进入90%正式测验。
brief.en: Discover and organize knowledge, then study worked reasoning and guided practice. These are new-situation applications with knowledge always available. Examples, favorites and foundation confirmation do not establish understanding. Formal assessment with a 90% threshold follows the chapter.

prompt.zh: 会议记录显示业务、技术和监督人员都讨论过项目，却写“决定责任由大家共同承担”，没有人确认最终用途，技术也不知道谁接收异常。选择修订交接表的必要项。
prompt.en: Business, technical and oversight staff discussed the project, but the handover says everyone jointly owns decisions. Nobody confirms intended use, and engineers do not know the incident receiver. Select necessary repairs.

text.zh: 把会议参与名单复制到责任栏即可
text.en: Copy the meeting attendance list into the owner field

text.zh: 明确业务、技术、监督如何交接与接收异常
text.en: Define business, technical and oversight handovers and incident ownership

text.zh: 明确各决定的负责人及授权边界
text.en: Name decision owners and their authority boundaries

reason.zh: 参与不等于决定责任。交接需要具体负责人、权责和接手关系；名单不能填补这些缺口。回看“跨职能治理与问责”。
reason.en: Participation is not decision ownership. Handover requires owners, authority and takeover arrangements; a list of names does not fill the gaps. Revisit Cross-Functional Governance and Accountability.

prompt.zh: 项目已经整理用途、受影响人群、资料类别、使用地区和组织要求，并为每项附了证据。负责人尚未作具体适用判断。产品经理因“材料齐全”准备直接标为风险审查通过。此时哪些记录状态有依据？
prompt.en: The project has documented use, affected people, data classes, regions and organizational requirements with evidence for each. The accountable reviewer has not made a contextual assessment. The product lead wants to mark risk review passed because the brief is complete. Which recorded states are supported?

text.zh: 仍应把已经有证据的全部字段改成缺失
text.en: Mark all already evidenced fields missing again

text.zh: 审查是否通过仍待有责任的专业判断，不能由材料齐全推定
text.en: Review approval awaits accountable professional judgment; completeness does not imply it

text.zh: 字段填满即证明所有合规风险已排除
text.en: Completed fields prove every compliance risk is excluded

text.zh: 上下文材料已准备，可提交相关责任人核对适用条件
text.en: The context brief is ready for accountable assessment of applicable conditions

reason.zh: 准备好上下文支持开展评估，不等于已经完成评估。既不能把材料齐全自动升级成审查通过，也不应忽略已有证据反复要求同一材料。回看“合规风险识别”。
reason.en: Complete context enables review without completing it. Do not turn a ready brief into approval, or ignore evidence and repeatedly request the same inputs. Revisit Compliance Risk Identification.
